[**May 30, 1806:** Andrew Jackson shot and killed Charles Dickinson in a duel in Adairville, Kentucky. Dickinson was an attorney from Nashville who made derogatory remarks about Jackson’s wife, Rachel and accused the future president of cheating on horse betting. The pair met to duel on the Jeff Burr Farm. Jackson was never prosecuted for murder, and it did not hinder his bid for the presidency later in life.](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=26023797e5f441299a5f6472062344b8&_e=r4hfSI1e6kZXWtymXojclFTt55WOtJDXFHELuS0GoWKvqW_jYn9_npsaMixVWJAEgidSNcb0NNHVt_hFkD2UlOdpNLLaZ1qXLSuKxR7FK-PzIqqdA7Ig-X9ocuOPRW5rodSdS4DXKljdyXtHOucLCgp9hm5-IExR13FmowxhGfSAfvZZl9TdX4nDlkoLD_5AXkWQfH8vbq-RXMIKAYWWA2uCzLRVCDK05p4c4KwJiIWQ1zTYRaJl_N4r-0aNZAS08hmC8QzxM2-yd6M5xIoRm4H39zIv14lDXu8rdAKns9vTDw_XbBpWP4Bd0NsYvFZL6Z4Y6EsSfwC4nhezEE-r0PC-nfDF2wo4Zc3aY8O6ZH4%3D) **Source -[ky.gov](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=26023797e5f441299a5f6472062344b8&_e=r4hfSI1e6kZXWtymXojclFTt55WOtJDXFHELuS0GoWKvqW_jYn9_npsaMixVWJAEgidSNcb0NNHVt_hFkD2UlOdpNLLaZ1qXLSuKxR7FK-PzIqqdA7Ig-X9ocuOPRW5rodSdS4DXKljdyXtHOucLCgp9hm5-IExR13FmowxhGfSAfvZZl9TdX4nDlkoLD_5AkeOABATnP6Kh53jSphMaRIsk6gOFlUcWhtF0bYyuqI8Yq8qg4vvxFfqfkE17IsQ_qaLYaFbQSBSi4eGZPBuyfa4L12ghS0XNAjTu8oXTubHCNCQeEY79n44av3Ta1voy-uax3WQT236KP7xuYz_pBk8Ugy2gq_eIavI7fiuCcGQ%3D)[](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=26023797e5f441299a5f6472062344b8&_e=r4hfSI1e6kZXWtymXojclH3cpI0n5vzwYUuqrzNQArU4tXJbSCgYdNRi8SYTT7bNibppDdb9LNNWZR3O-LI3Cb-j_ERDGAjUhc8FkAD7qc5zlTlgqIernQ2rGJAipXWdGeMIFLsXQhz_ifoCfUlDQQ562-qqrGuGAmM78j18sQusKl27NRsmOuQ4ihWJFIp3-2DVUf7bKEaWlM7I61N5V-I6SBth9x2myX9Jk4R3D1gA6TrwTxyJ6MDKqm_Yha5F)**

[**May 30, 1911:** The first Indianapolis 500 was the start of a sporting event that would become known as the “Greatest Spectacle in Racing.” The title held true at the time, with this race being the longest course and offering the highest prize purse. Ray Harroun won the race with a time of 6 hours and 42 minutes. [**May 30, 1922:** The Lincoln Memorial was officially opened and dedicated with a ceremony held by Chief Justice of the United States/former President William Howard Taft, President Warren G. Harding, and Robert Todd Lincoln, Abraham Lincoln's son. The national monument was designed to resemble the Parthenon and used symbolism to evoke ideas of strength and unity. Over 50,000 people attended, and the ceremony was broadcasted over the radio.](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=26023797e5f441299a5f6472062344b8&_e=r4hfSI1e6kZXWtymXojclHrOriYIpQYueFPhj-DXq2mV7-5MHkA5-IzINyQdVMVm5Kcc-ZZulF0gr4sWZGLgiocTHkK96ECJ53uUKkxbcw5s88bFd6XWYaK-ioUmwgmbjKZl8eMmQ7pk22AEfRZ0zcwPWvzMjdc2--jgGGKD5Ao2gzkCDpBvxhbmM-4CBhPk1WarCjAcjuZsjYqSQd2Om-dFEYR8xSTvT7cz1xqCsrk%3D) **Source -[nps.gov](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=26023797e5f441299a5f6472062344b8&_e=r4hfSI1e6kZXWtymXojclHrOriYIpQYueFPhj-DXq2mV7-5MHkA5-IzINyQdVMVm5Kcc-ZZulF0gr4sWZGLgiu1-1eAvZNwdkQwdkbvqJJZpbWDozRAqHmQHaeJktnbRDzKnyJuRq0NzCLY3c_vM4kImDHU4kQXzHG-0FNLf3bjb7i1iQUSqq27AnQNuFEpAYntu0_NSy1q2HMOzNlIWrxaesB70ux5rLDYorLQvUd0%3D)**

Peter, I’m reaching out personally because I need to ask a favor of you today. Yes, this is a fundraising ask, and I wish I didn’t have to make it. But it’s important that I have the resources to win re-election, so I hope you will hear me out.

The truth is I hate asking people to contribute. It’s the worst part of this job, and our democracy would be better off if we could get these absurd levels of money out of our politics. The corporate and dark money is undoubtedly a corrosive force.
But my campaign cannot just unilaterally disarm. It would put a huge target on us for far-right billionaires that can spend limitless sums of money. Senate races are just expensive, and frankly, people deserve to know that I’m putting in the work of legislating in the Senate and organizing on the ground to earn their vote.
That’s why I’m building a people-powered campaign from start to finish. I’m going to fund this the right way but it requires that I lean on you a bit more.

Look, I know you probably did not expect to make a contribution to my re-election when you woke up this morning, but if you believe that people power is the right way to run a campaign, then I need you to have my back.
**[Please split a contribution of $5](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/64079319/408902347/912806569?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk33-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOTZhNjFjZS00NmZmLWVkMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=oTAz0M1S5kagK_jIQHug6Yk5o7Q02Jkd69xbUVEqrdQ=)****[between my campaign and Patty Murray today. Please know I only ask because your support is truly important. Every best wish,

Chris Murphy

[_**We’re setting an EMERGENCY flash goal to raise $1,000 in the next 24 hours to hit it —****and we desperately need your support.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/64079994/408916302/-1193769910?refcode=AU_HTP_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20230530_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDI1NDMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTVjMzE3YjgtNGJmZi1lZDExLTkwN2MtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=F-m6dWThqmcXeMdxwxleVBNC8Hn1ipCU_W9oBRwXd_E=) Our fundraising goals aren’t just arbitrary numbers, and they’re not meant to scare you. Patriot,

I thought I'd see a HUGE response to my first annual GOP Speaker's Survey, but it hasn't happened.

This input is desperately needed to shape the party's strategy for this MUST-WIN election. Joe Biden and the liberal media hate that we are so closely involved with our grassroots base. This survey is the type of thing that gives him nightmares.

You don't have to write anything fancy, just tell me what matters to you.

So, I'm inviting you one LAST time today.

subject: what I don’t believe about politics.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron DeSantis for President
body:
I think most candidates get this wrong, and I want to set the record straight.

---
| | | | | | | | | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zpd3flhlbo6beaific8qq05n8lcun7c49qkharko_)
---

Friend,

I don't believe politics is entertainment. I don't believe politics is building a brand or virtue signaling.

Ultimately, politics is about **WINNING** and about **PRODUCING RESULTS.**

So instead of writing you a long email about what I believe, I just want to show you what I've DONE in Florida.

**Do you want results like these for all of America?** **[Then join my campaign today.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zpsd6v20or9ihiorbo3tqibpur0c29deua86vgho_ "Then join my campaign today.")**
---
| | [Donate](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zampf2o2smgigk1krkncga5l7tnniremi8df53o8_)
---
Ron DeSantis

**RON DESANTIS GOT RESULTS FOR FLORIDA**
---
| | | **K-12 Education**

Parents' rights have been increasingly under assault around the nation, but in Florida, we stand up for the rights of parents and the fundamental role they play in the education of their children.
* School choice is available for all Floridians by eliminating enrollment caps and income requirements while still prioritizing lower-income families and expanding scholarships for students with special needs.

* Florida is now the first state in the nation to have school choice fully integrated in the public K-12 funding process.

* Florida is ranked #1 in education freedom, #1 in parental empowerment, #1 in state spending on private school choice, and #1 in school choice enrollment.

* Florida eliminated Critical Race Theory in its K-12 schools.

* In 2021 Florida created annual increases in scholarships for students with special needs and we provided $750 for transportation costs to the chosen school.

* Florida has established robust civics education requirements so that students learn about the constitution and what it means to be an American.

**Higher Education Reform**

Academia, writ large, across the country, has lost its way. In Florida, we're changing that with a series of reforms:
* Ending tenure by instating regular performance reviews.

* Dismantling the monopolistic style of higher ed accreditation agencies.

* Resetting the focus of higher ed towards preparing students to be contributing members of society, rather than imposing political ideology.

* Ensuring students and staff are evaluated based on merit and eliminating so-called D.E.I. programs, which are effectively programs based in discrimination, exclusion, and indoctrination.

**China**

Ron DeSantis has taken action to stand against the United States' greatest geopolitical threat -- the Chinese Communist Party (CCP). He signed legislation that:
* Prevents Chinese entities or affiliates from buying farmland in Florida or land near our military bases.

* Stops sensitive data from being stored on servers that might be owned by entities affiliated with the CCP.

* Prohibits the Chinese influence that we rooted out of higher education from working its way into our primary and secondary education institutions, including a prohibition on Confucious institutes.

* Blocks access to dangerous applications, such as TikTok, on government servers and devices.

**Protecting Life **
* The Heartbeat Protection Act protects the most vulnerable: babies in the womb whose hearts have already begun to beat.

**Defending 2nd Amendment Rights **
* Enacted constitutional carry that allows Floridians to carry concealed weapons without a government-issued permission slip.

**Law and Order**

Other states endanger their citizens by making it easier to put criminals back on the street. Here in Florida, we support and enact policies to protect our communities and keep our people safe. Governor DeSantis signed reforms that:
* Strengthen pre-trial detention and pushed back against woke "bail reform" efforts

* Increasing sentences for drug traffickers that target children with dangerous fentanyl.

* Subjected child rapists to the death penalty while simultaneously reforming death penalty statutes to ensure justice.

* Gov. DeSantis is also the only elected official in America to remove a "progressive" Soros-funded district attorney from office.

**Immigration**

The Biden Border Crisis has wreaked havoc across the United States and has put Americans in danger. But Governor DeSantis did not stand idly by while the federal government abandoned its lawful duties to protect our country, instead he:
* Mandated immigration status verification through E-Verify for public and private employers.

* Made knowingly transporting illegal immigrant minors a felony.

* Made using a fake ID to gain employment a felony.

* Required hospitals to report healthcare costs for illegal aliens.

* Gave Florida more money to send more illegal immigrants to more "sanctuary" jurisdictions such as Martha's Vineyard.

**Prescription Drugs**

Pharmacy benefit managers and Big Pharma have managed to escape the public eye and work in the shadows for far too long. Ron DeSantis signed a bill that takes the reins back from these healthcare monopolies while empowering consumers.
* With the legislation passed this session, drug companies must disclose wholesale drug price increases of 15% or more.

* Florida is also prohibiting pharmacy benefit managers from mandating mail orders.

**Tax Cuts**

Florida's economy has consistently outpaced the nation, but we are still fighting against inflationary policies imposed on us by the Biden administration. IIn Florida, we supported our residents and helped them afford the goods that they need.
* We lowered tolls across the state.

* We created a permanent tax exemption on diapers, wipes, baby clothes, cribs, strollers, and much more.

* We reduced taxes by nearly $5 billion - a Florida record.

**Legal Reform and Housing**

As Florida's population booms, we have provided record support for Florida's workforce to get quality housing and live the American Dream.
* The Live Local Act dedicates more than half a billion dollars to incentivize and jumpstart new construction.

* The Hometown Heroes Program makes sure police officers, firefighters, teachers, and other community leaders can afford to live in or near the communities they serve.

**Environmental, social, and corporate governance & Central Bank Digital Currency **

Ron DeSantis refuses to let elites circumvent the ballot box to implement a radical ideological agenda through financial sleight of hand.
* Governor DeSantis signed legislation that prohibits the financial sector from considering so-called "Social Credit Scores" in banking and lending practices that aim to prevent Floridians from obtaining loans, lines of credit, and bank accounts.

* And Governor DeSantis is on the record: NO to CBDCs or Federally-controlled digital dollar. Any proposal will be dead on arrival.

**Let Kids Be Kids **

There is a disturbing trend in our society to try to sexualize young people. That is not the way you look out for our children. You protect children--and Governor DeSantis has, by signing landmark legislation that:
* Prohibits sex reassignment surgeries and prescriptions for children under 18.

* Bans children from attending drag shows.

* Protects students from having to "declare" their pronouns in school and ensures that students are not forced to use pronouns that are not based on a student's biological sex.

* Expands parents' rights in the education of their children by prohibiting classroom instruction on sexual orientation and gender identity in Pre-K through 8th grade.

* Protects young women from being forced to use bathrooms and locker rooms alongside biological males who have decided that they can invade women's spaces.

---
| | **These kinds of accomplishments are why Floridians re-elected Ron DeSantis as their governor by a whopping 20-point margin, turning Democrat strongholds red. We need candidates and proven records who can win --that's Ron DeSantis. Are you ready to win big for ALL of America? **

**Meet Ron DeSantis**
---
| | | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zu6tr32cdpntoda6inh2f46h920vi4g2d8oksj90_rp22sh2s8i66o75clh6eoj2c3h2bs)
---
| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

## McCarthy in Peril Over Debt Bill
House Speaker Kevin McCarthy's leadership role [is in peril](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGupCAUQL9GO4yA4lBQbGM3225prnARdhEM3B0zf_8yr37dSU5zcv48tyfEFPPxG0405MsGluILt3FmkjMhN9E74xEFyh4NV495llKJpQ9m0hrU7LlfZtCTw2kHp1HgAwGVFaKPRoxCjrPkfORS8mFWzupp4sC1U5zrbhrRRSp1-FtipoA-vcsL62DL2ScTiK7WyV-dWDux3vc95N1mvNvHd2K9SooUbevEaks-KrYPeqisxiMQO_HcsTb2Pwe4rjdzuBNzCIn5VIAYhYpAmGM-2GktVArvxtqF8A9ZtRkeatFLX4277phSbGrppvE4IabvQvp52FcAAAD__86yb64) over his support of the debt-ceiling bill. Many conservative members of Congress are deeply unhappy with the debt deal and have discussed calling a vote to force McCarthy out. At least one House Republican, Dan Bishop, has already publicly stated his support [for ousting McCarthy.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsUj2T3CAM_TVs5x0hGWwKF5ncbHcpckXKHQFiTeKvsfHd7L_P2Je5KhWPB4-HnvTr9f7KecjT4weP0pU03zmU_C53MBXpCumOl9glERS6SKdtawyRxebSd95HZ6MPsYWWsdXJs00xGW0sxVrokjsEJDCkNWgifTU2BlfXmrWLVmunapCYy7xef895Kr2k4Tm_y3oN83gZur6UZVP0TeFN4a300udhOM4U3vp5lEk-thPumyi81YCWmqZKed1Ktcqy-yEHnqpPMDyrbV-WeS1bNe9bydOjGkPgtfTPirdqW4T_yHqY0U1GzoOiF7A2gHOQuNYUDQZqa0zouEb2HjElBhAWhfaU8KHBQEQNWwsGyVjSvg3sUQApmvrrrlf0IhCpYW-TaySCdbpOII1hLV6ibQhAc6tTk9raNW1KDsElEqTUeDaRFNq9jPdt3tcgil7eOA-lX_d__Cgx7-Phc9bzSQYeF86P6fiquRJckRQahLef5_Iavp-ZnJuvUAzCEZqsl7WLy0cehrzZRtXwOF4-G1b-Pz9_AwAA___iwL39) More than a dozen Republicans are on record opposing the debt bill. Other members of the conservative House Freedom Caucus, who held up McCarthy's original election to Speaker through 17 ballots, have threatened consequences if the bill passes. ["There's going to be a reckoning,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0UGr3CAUBeBfY3Z3UG80usii8Mjuddvl4ORe39g6GoxMmH9fMlBooW7PBwfP_fF5_Qwpp_L1PTx47rFew9rTk6_SACrQeNUDzZFZMw48K-uMQbR6Gu5zVGGSxjk5TX4kK5V2t9EYZ8hFhUYNadZSozSolFSI6mIsrX4cVVCerFJejJIp9douP2sq_c4xv-qT22WtjyHP9963XeA3oRehl-M4LlvNqae1nkDopfCxZ-6d2y70suXwutX6C7YzO6uFXqQRekEp9LLWsnN7hvN7O7QaGtQCxLcOK783gFAIHusaWr-_QErpvbZW4FJKeLDAj38abEkk8EOeT5kARMhABi0EnG5ANEVyIZ7xidtfemSIkgmIPEKgKUJ0TIEm_0fnt_Z2RO2GNtN2pJzTbicxyq9HSPk9Uf__xX4HAAD__5iEjoQ)" said GOP Rep. ## AI Leaders Fear Humanity’s Extinction
Top CEOs of artificial intelligence companies issued a [public statement](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGP4yAQRn8N7rCYAdtxQZHiXF2uOmlLi5hJPLsYIiBx8u9X2Xqrr_j0pKf3cZpPjgPH6z-3ka2XNLul8oNm1UkNEvWMjbcXIiTdkIX-0HVa9zg0qz2YEenQD2gWhXAeCHogZ8jowXfjoBq2qFCrTgMo0BrarvfLaAw4GH0PMAqjyHNNuf1MHOtKl_BKD8rtkrYm2LXWWxH6KHASOO373m4lvj-BE0V5LwKnSPt7Ul0pC5wcy8zlq8hAznO8yvW-ucj1JWuS9Kwcl8opSnreKNcid5fjG8vyeITz_8ffP022_rZzCFz6QRh13RyHH6H6e5_vAAAA__-VbGbL) warning that AI technology poses a "risk of extinction" for humanity--at the same level as a pandemic or nuclear war. The urgent statement is signed by nearly 400 AI experts, including Sam Altman, the chief executive of OpenAI and its ChatGPT engine, and Demis Hassabis, the CEO of Google DeepMind. The public apparently shares their concerns: A [recent Reuters poll ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGu4yAQheGnwR0WDAaSgmIbd9l2S2vWjGNW2EQwjuW3X-Xqlrc-0tGn_89jemDKaX_-xo0CL2XCmdObJmWl0RLMBF0MCxGQ6Shod7PWGAe-W4P9S8qgG3R0YD1EP3uyRIQAeDPedCmAAqOs0VppY3RvXZzvw6BR36PT-i4GRTFxqf2_knZeaclXeVPt57J1OazMrybMLwGjgPE8z77SwVTbZxcwMs3rXnJ5XgJGTJLXSsi0N7keG-6JryaXg49K0mmJG9U0495kw0t-P6VXK01-mFJZqb2Asashvs6Uc2rOi0E9N0z5S8Q_B_ofAAD__wZiZ7I)found that 61% of Americans believe AI could threaten civilization.
## Drones Attack Wealthy Moscow Suburb
One of Moscow's most exclusive neighborhoods, where Vladimir Putin and other top Russian leaders have homes, [was hit by drones](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD1vhSAYhX8Nbq_hQ1AHhi5ut2tHg_B6pUExgJfef9_Yues5yclznq_H_DA--OP5aXbUZY2zscW_cKYSBAMuZt44vSJyFA1qpgYphVC8bzYt-mVg3ComaU-HYZGjWobeDqvAfrXL2njNKRdUCsYoE4K1Ujk7dh0zbHSKsZF0FJ0vMbXf0R9lwzW84wtTa-PeBL2VcmYiPgifCJ9qrW3Cq2DKd38nMQVH-IRXiicSPqUrZ28O2E_I5p2hbAkRXIoHZnCxHujg3gf8seHK_oWwx2xjhXwtV1rg5oX7OiV8apJ2Z_Uh-Kx60tHnbnz4Qyv_m_oNAAD__6Vmatg) Tuesday morning. It was the first time that residential areas of the city had been targeted since the war with Ukraine began. Putin called the drone attack a "terrorist action" by Ukraine. The attacks damaged several buildings and forced evacuations, but no casualties were reported. Fellow Patriot, I want to draw your attention to the headline below. **America First Legal Sues the Arizona Secretary of State and Department of State for Illegally Concealing Public Records Related to the 2022 Midterm Elections in Maricopa County...** As you know, the 2022 midterm election in Arizona was perhaps the most controversial in the Nation and the most contested in Arizona history. And now, his lies have gotten him into serious legal trouble–a [13 count indictment](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tdfd001fb-d13d-4982-907f-fa49efeebf5e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) ranging from wire fraud to false statements to theft of public money. And the public has a right to be concerned. As a member of Congress, Santos could have access to classified information and was the final [vote](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td1e633ae-e6e3-41db-9efc-12077a4f4a92/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) to seal the GOP’s destructive debt limit ploy. House Leader McCarthy is already backing off [expulsion](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3e95c628-f37d-4969-ad75-59a9ccc2a9a7/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)–but that shouldn’t matter. Santos has betrayed his constituents–who have [called](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7659375c-7ff9-476c-8427-4a75d3148eee/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) for his resignation–the American people, and is now facing serious criminal charges. He must resign immediately. [**Sign the petition: George Santos must resign.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7ec665cf-a642-4f41-a87f-0ec670c0b3ac/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Cliff

body:
| | |
---
I just got off the phone with several conservative leaders in Washington who asked us to continue to put pressure on the House to STOP the debt ceiling bill from passing. Yesterday we weren’t sure if we could actually stop it, but now more and more Republicans are coming out against it. We have the momentum and today is critical to stop the Biden-McCarthy deal from going through. Here’s what is happening today: The House will have two votes on the Biden-McCarthy debt deal.
1. A vote on the rule, expected around 3:30 pm Eastern
2. A vote on final passage, expected around 8:30 pm Eastern

That means there are two bites at the apple to kill the bill. What many Members of Congress will do is vote to pass the rule and then vote against the final bill. Voting for the rule before voting against the bill is voting for the bill before voting against it. Call your congressman/woman and ask your Member of Congress to vote AGAINST the rule AND against the final bill.

Dear Friend,
I hear from people all the time that Thomas Sowell is one of their heroes. "Tax cuts for the rich" is a favorite argument of those who oppose lower tax rates. But does imposing higher tax rates on wealthy Americans actually increase the amount of revenue coming into the federal government?
Hoover Institution Senior Fellow **Thomas Sowell takes an empirical approach** in his commentary, [**_"_****_Trickle Down " Theory and "Tax Cuts for the Rich._****_"_**](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61865929:W-du-aDNW:m:1:2532013465:DEA742ECE9A22E324A5D234201FEBDA0:r)
Sowell separates fact from fiction when it comes to tax rates and uses real life data and examples to prove that lower tax rates for all actually lead to greater revenue for the government.
As a friend and supporter of the Hoover Institution, we are proud to offer you this valuable, thought-provoking resource free of charge. The Biden administration is using taxpayer dollars to attack conservatives and Republicans.

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5jvccnvthc0s74s3ju6s3ccpf0i08o7d223kua0_rp22sh2s8i66o75clim4pb6chh2bs)

They set up the Disinformation Government Board, targeted parents as terrorists, and funded the Global Disinformation Index censorship machine.

Now we have proof that Biden is actively targeting conservatives as terrorists.

MRC Free Speech America learned how the Biden administration is weaponizing the Targets Violence and Terrorism Prevention program in an effort to destroy conservatives, Christians, and the Republican Party.

Before I go any further, let me introduce myself. I'm Brent Bozell, President of the Media Research Center (MRC). **But once Biden took office, the Terrorism Prevention Program was renamed, revamped, and refocused to silence conservatives, Christians, and the Republican Party. **

Instead of focusing on preventing actual violence and terrorism, the program is now being used to target the entire spectrum of the political right and Christians through _" media literacy and online critical thinking initiatives."_

They should call it what it is, _**indoctrination and censorship**_.

This is all part of their coordinated effort to make America a one-party system.

[Do you want to stop the radical Left from taking over this country? Then please help us expose their underhanded tactics to the American people by donating today >>>](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zmiuupkqq5h8b2dhe11bp027tigbieta95sl23oo_rp22sh2s8i66o75clim4pb6chh2bs)

One of the researchers paid by our government terrorism program, Michael Loadenthal, is a self-proclaimed member of a radical leftwing Antifa group. He openly boasted that _**" a lot of things we're doing are illegal" and "a lot of it involves breaking the law."**_

He created the "Pyramid of Far-Right Radicalization" that he claimed depicts the "modern far-right" and extremism in America:

**_The Biden administration is doing more than censoring conservatives_.** They are trying to shut down conservative websites, close our meetings, and physically prevent us from assembling in public. They are turning the federal government against all Republicans.

subject: RITE Confronts Partisan Activists in Montana, New Hampshire, Florida, and Pennsylvania
body:
| | |
---
| |
---
| RITE is fighting legal battles in nine states to stop activists from eliminating democratically enacted laws that preserve order in our elections. In Montana, we are supporting the state in defending its recently adopted law that bans paid ballot harvesting (among other integrity changes). In Florida and Pennsylvania, RITE is working to prevent the removal of signature and dating requirements. Read more ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️
---
|
---
|
## **1\. 🗳️ RITE to Montana Supreme Court: State Legislatures Have the Power to Manage Elections**

Montana was one of the first states to ban paid ballot harvesting, a tactic used by the activist left to pad election results. In _Montana Democratic Party v. Jacobsen_ , RITE is helping Montana defend its constitutional right to manage its elections, including implementing a paid-ballot harvesting ban.

In 2021, plaintiffs, including those backed by activist attorney Marc Elias, challenged four Montana laws: HB176, eliminating Election Day registration; SB169, establishing that student IDs may not be used as the primary ID for voting; HB530, eliminating for-hire ballot harvesting; and HB506, prohibiting absentee ballots from being sent to minors. RITE **[filed an amicus brief](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=88b470875b&e=ea91f782ea)** before the Montana Supreme Court, defending the state’s laws. (**[Read More](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=4cad3d9479&e=ea91f782ea)**)

## **2. In Florida, RITE Exposes Elias’s Misuse of The Civil Rights Act**

RITE’s May Mailman takes to the pages of **[The Miami Herald](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=55c7a51d0e&e=ea91f782ea)** to explain how Marc Elias is abusing the Civil Rights Act in a blatant attempt to undermine Florida’s election integrity rules.

**[The Miami Herald](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=35adef3d2f&e=ea91f782ea):**

_The materiality provision of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 was enacted to end racially discriminatory voting restrictions that would require Black voters to provide trivial details like the exact number of months and days of age. It says an elections official cannot “deny the right of any individual to vote” based on an error or omission “not material” to whether the voter is qualified under state law to vote. It was an important law because racist registrars across the Jim Crow South were bent on keeping Black people out of the polling booth.

But it has no relevance in the challenge to Florida’s signature law, which denies no one the right to vote. It’s not hard to vote in Florida. In 2020, 11 million Floridians found their way to the polls, in person or by mail, for a 77% voter turnout, far above the national average. (**[Read More](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=1022bb488d&e=ea91f782ea)**)_

RITE PAC is an **[active backer of the defense](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=c150fc0f77&e=ea91f782ea)** in the underlying case _Vote.org v. Byrd_ , supporting the RNC and Republican Party of Pasco County in defending Florida’s election law.

## **3\. New Hampshire Court Backs RITE in Defense of Voter ID Law**

The trial court in New Hampshire approved RITE PAC’s entry into an important case defending the Granite State’s ID checks on those who register on election day. The case, _603 Forward v. Scanlon_ , was orchestrated by activists to undermine the legislature’s right to administer orderly elections. RITE PAC is asking the trial court to dismiss the challenge outright because New Hampshire should have every right to verify the identity and residency of those who vote in the state’s elections.

## **4\. Undated Mail Ballots Crux of Pennsylvania Election Law Challenge**

The Commonwealth of Pennsylvania has a simple election law: voters must sign and date their mail ballot. Leftist groups believe that evenly applied requirement is discriminatory. Earlier, before the midterm elections, RITE **[won its case](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=bd244b9fa3&e=ea91f782ea)** to enforce the law. But plaintiff groups have not relented. In _Eakin v. Adams County_ , plaintiffs argue the date requirement violates the “materiality provision” of the Civil Rights Act – a provision designed to stop Jim Crow-era racist registrars from disqualifying voters but does not prohibit basic rules around how to vote. A date requirement is perfectly lawful. RITE looks forward to a victory in the suit.

## **5\. Georgia Bolsters ZuckBucks Law**

Georgia Governor Brian Kemp signed a stricter statewide ban blocking the harmful outside influence of private funds from being used to administer elections. Georgia lawmakers are smartly keeping private money and activist agendas out of its elections. In February, RITE filed a complaint with the State Election Board detailing illegal conduct by DeKalb County to evade the state’s existing Zuckbucks ban and helped bring this issue back to the forefront of the state’s policy agenda. We will continue working to hold DeKalb County accountable for its conduct. RITE is also urging other states to join Georgia in combat the relentless schemes of the activist left to cheapen and undermine the sanctity of the electoral process. (**[Read More](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=f76c7e31ca&e=ea91f782ea)**)

body:
It's a positive development that both sides have found common ground to help protect America's economy.| | | [](http://links.johnkasich.com/u/click?_t=6a3b28686d0a4d77958e12349305a4fe&_m=7403d5f8bf2843609f71ff58b9c679a6&_e=csB2PzlmA5pxOsBO-UJZdo7L3_8wd0QRVrC_npawWHuo6m3MsLLOYK-EdIpF484-8TfUdkrgHMULNwmU1v6cG_Au2F85dUrDpVpznaHOotLhSVOwws7hkBv83Ga6ukJBuBlOrwb158aqhEDLCW_YLn8JIA1wNYkrNMHYGeDaBtkhKq68YVSiIlBP7QSODdIe9MMoumUOgCnRRzt35w84lQ%3D%3D)
---
Peter, While there is nothing transformational in the debt ceiling agreement announced between President Biden and Speaker McCarthy, it's a positive development that both sides have found common ground to help protect America's economy.

As I posted on social media last week, a compromise that doesn't make anybody happy is usually the solution. The question now is if both sides can continue to work together to get enough members of Congress to support the deal. I am optimistic that they will be able to do so

Those of you who remember the Reagan presidency may know that Democrat Speaker Tip O'Neil and Reagan were able to find common ground on many major issues. This is how Washington is supposed to work, everyone giving a little to achieve a solution, and I'm glad to see this latest hopeful development.

I wish though that the agreement would have included a mechanism, such as a bipartisan panel or Presidential Commission, to help Americans understand the looming crisis of the long-term debt and entitlement issues. The more debt we have, the higher the interest payments will be on that debt, and the more strain that puts on America's spending priorities. It's not sustainable.

Compromise isn't easy, but as I've tried to demonstrate in my time in elected office, you can compromise on policy goals without compromising your values. That's what democracy is all about, and it's our only hope for ensuring that the America we've seen in our lifetimes will continue for future generations. I discussed this on MSNBC on Sunday morning:

clean_body: It's a positive development that both sides have found common ground to help protect America's economy.| | | Peter, While there is nothing transformational in the debt ceiling agreement announced between President Biden and Speaker McCarthy, it's a positive development that both sides have found common ground to help protect America's economy. As I posted on social media last week, a compromise that doesn't make anybody happy is usually the solution. The question now is if both sides can continue to work together to get enough members of Congress to support the deal. I am optimistic that they will be able to do so Those of you who remember the Reagan presidency may know that Democrat Speaker Tip O'Neil and Reagan were able to find common ground on many major issues. This is how Washington is supposed to work, everyone giving a little to achieve a solution, and I'm glad to see this latest hopeful development. I wish though that the agreement would have included a mechanism, such as a bipartisan panel or Presidential Commission, to help Americans understand the looming crisis of the long-term debt and entitlement issues. The more debt we have, the higher the interest payments will be on that debt, and the more strain that puts on America's spending priorities. It's not sustainable. Compromise isn't easy, but as I've tried to demonstrate in my time in elected office, you can compromise on policy goals without compromising your values. That's what democracy is all about, and it's our only hope for ensuring that the America we've seen in our lifetimes will continue for future generations. I discussed this on MSNBC on Sunday morning: | "Bipartisan Debt Ceiling Agreement" | In case you missed it, I recently co-authored an op-ed for Newsweek with former Democrat Congressman Tim Penny about how both sides can work together to balance America's budget. . You can count on me to continue raising this issue and rally Americans to pressure their elected leaders to put the nasty partisan politics aside and do the hard work of governing for the American people. Together, we will continue to challenge our leaders to work toward policy solutions and needed reforms instead of using issues to divide us. . Together, we can bring about positive change and fight for America. I'm so appreciative for your ongoing support. Updates from Peter Hernandez for Congress | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/bcb4fad3b6f4/looking-forward-to-9147080?e=638e6c2751)

| | |
# Why Even Pretend To Have A Debt Ceiling Anymore?
As the debate heats up this week over House Speaker McCarthy's "negotiated" debt ceiling agreement with Biden, I can't help but feel that we are beating our heads against the same sorry wall. How many times have we held out hope that our representatives in DC would, because all signs were pointing to "a bankrupt nation is not in the best interest of the American People," finally opt for fiscal sanity and stop spending our grandchildren's money? What started out as a strong stand from the House Republicans to walk back much of Biden's trillion dollar sprees now feels like we've been betrayed once again.

Why even have a "debt limit" if you never have to worry about bouncing up against it? The unbelievable 40% increase in government spending of the last several years (because Covid!) is now our new normal. The pundits are all over the map, claiming wins and losses from this "Fiscal Responsibility" bill that [you can read here.](https://hernandezforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=314f047675baff18221b82bdc&id=8d8511f322&e=638e6c2751)

We have to get our fiscal house in order. For the last many weeks I have been on the phone with donors and supporters across this great nation. They are universally tired of business as usual out of Washington, DC. There is no way to stop this leviathan government beast without cutting off the blood flow. I watch with interest how the lines will be drawn this week, and applaud those who don't assist in paving the road of "good intentions."

Thank you for your support!
Peter Hernandez

subject: It's been a busy month
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ANDY BESHEAR FOR GOVERNOR
body:
May has been busy for our campaign and a lot has changed in our race It's been a busy few weeks, Peter!

Earlier this month, we learned that I will be facing Mitch McConnell's protégé, Daniel Cameron, in November. With the primary behind us, this race for Kentucky governor is officially on. Election experts are calling this one of the most important elections in the country this year and we can be certain that all eyes will be on Kentucky.

To help us kickstart the general election, we embarked on a three-day, thirteen-stop bus tour across Kentucky. I had the opportunity to talk with Kentuckians all over the Commonwealth, and I was blown away by their energy and excitement. Either way, it's an honor to represent your voice in the Senate.

God bless you, and have a great rest of your day,

Marsha

body:

I need your urgent help to expose the LA Dodgers baseball team
for blatantly supporting an anti-Christian hate group.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWYdadaDXN

I need
your urgent help to expose the LA Dodgers baseball team for
blatantly supporting an anti-Christian hate group.

The group
calls itself the "Sisters of Perpetual Indulgence."

And their
motto is "go forth and sin some more."

The
"sisters" are a bunch of men who dress up in sexually explicit
and rainbow-colored "nun" clothing with one purpose:

To mock
Christians.

Then they
perform stunts designed to be as shocking and offensive as
possible.

A
"condom savior mass"
An
annual "Jesus in drag" competition
Pole
dancing on a cross
And
much more.

They even
tricked an archbishop into giving them communion, then defiled
the Eucharist.

And the
Dodgers are choosing to honor this anti-Christian hate group with
their "Community Hero Award" during so-called "Pride month."

FIGHT
BACK

It's
vile.

It's
disgusting.

It's a
blatant attack by a major American corporation on our Lord.

And
faithful Christians like you and I must not tolerate this kind of
hatred.

That's
why CatholicVote is raising $1 million to run ads on every
Dodgers-linked radio station and TV channel to send a clear
message:

Any
business that promotes anti-Catholic bigotry WILL suffer the
consequences.

FLOOD
THE AIRWAYS!

If you've
been following the news closely, you may have read about
CatholicVote's campaign to ask the Dodgers to remove this
anti-Catholic group of fake "sisters" from their celebration.

Thanks to
our public pressure campaign, thousands of CatholicVote
supporters FLOODED Dodger stadium with phone calls.

Within
minutes, we filled up their voicemail inboxes.

The
Dodgers almost immediately disinvited the "sisters."

A HUGE
thank-you to everyone who made those calls!

I'm
incredibly proud of our CatholicVote family for taking action
right away.

But
unfortunately Patriot, the story doesn't end there.

As soon
as the Dodgers disinvited the "sisters," the leftwing LGBT
movement went crazy.

Other gay
and transgender groups began to pressure and threaten the Dodgers
for daring to cross the LGBT agenda.

Then, the
Dodgers re-invited the Sisters of Perpetual Indulgence back and
decided to honor them with the baseball team's "Community Hero
Award."

They also
offered their "sincerest apologies to the Sisters of Perpetual
Indulgence, members of the LGBTQ+ community and their friends and
families."

And they
made the decision without even consulting any faithful Christians
- people like you and me. The Christians who the "Sisters of
Perpetual Indulgence" target with their hatred in the first
place.

It's
shocking, but not surprising.

Patriot,
this is the state of American culture today.

If anyone
dares to call a "transgender" person by their biological name or
pronoun, they risk being fired by woke corporations.

But those
same woke businesses heap honor on bigots who insult Christians,
hate our biblical values, and mock our Lord and Savior.

DEFEND
CHRIST!

As
Senator Marco Rubio said last night after the news broke, "Today
our great country is controlled by socio-political ruling elites
who don't just tolerate anti-Christian bigotry, they encourage &
celebrate it."

He's spot
on, Patriot.

One thing
is absolutely clear today:

Hate has
a home at Dodger stadium.

And it's
our job to stand up for the majesty of our Lord and our Church.

For God
and for country,

Brian
Burch

President, CatholicVote

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
P.S. Like
I mentioned earlier, we've set a goal to raise $1 million to run
ads exposing the anti-Christian bigotry of the LA Dodgers and the
"Sisters of Perpetual Indulgence."

Please
click here to donate anything you can spare today.

We didn't
have this in our budget, and we need to raise the money in the
next few days. So no matter what you can afford to chip in -
please don't hesitate. The most important thing is time.

Thank you
in advance, and please keep our work in your prayers.

body:
https://www.everyaction.com/ [https://www.everyaction.com/]
Peter,
Throughout the month following the adjournment of our legislative session, our House Democratic Caucus traveled the state, mobilized communities and began raising badly needed funds. More Tennesseans are joining our fight to end the Republican supermajority every day, and we are counting on you to stand with us.
We can flip vulnerable Republican districts across the state in 2024, but only if we put in the work and build the foundation for success - NOW. We state legislators are only permitted to raise funds while the legislature is adjourned, so please do not hesitate to join our efforts today.
Can you make an investment in our 2024 Victory Fund? Click here to contribute before the month ends. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tnhousedems2023]
After an emotionally charged and trying legislative session, it has been nothing short of inspiring to meet with Democrats across the state at various Caucus events. We will continue traveling the state in the coming weeks and months, so please be on the lookout for an event in your city. For those in the greeter Chattanooga area, please save the date of June 12th, and join us at the law offices of David & Hoss, PC. RSVP and join our host committee here. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/davisjune12]
Thank you to everyone who has recently attended an event, contributed and/or spread the word about our ongoing fight. We have a long, steep road ahead, and we are counting on every individual to help us build a brighter future for Tennessee families.
With gratitude,
John Ray Clemmons
State Representative
Caucus Chairman

subject: Lincoln’s secret weapon
body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills

| This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zhpm44umfkckl2mlk9f54tq0njd09l88oel26738_rp22sh2s8i66o75clim6p76c5h2bs)

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** **** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

Memorial Day is a solemn day to remember the ones who gave the last full measure of devotion for our country, and for us.
You’d think a Veteran would honor that, and leave the politics to somebody else.
But on Memorial Day, of all days, Ron DeSantis decided to attack our Military. Too “woke” for him.

Don’t tell us you’re pro-military if you smear the people who serve in it, if you strip their rights away — and especially if you would pardon the traitors who attacked our democracy on January 6th.
That’s DeSantis’ record, and he’s proud of it. But to us, it’s unacceptable. And we can’t let him get away with it.

A lot of campaigns are urging you to donate before their self-constructed fundraising deadlines. They're probably making you feel terrible if you don't contribute too, aren't they?

At Team DeSantis we're taking a different approach.

Our entire fundraising & digital program's foundation is built on this principle: Our donors are a part of our team; they are NOT our personal piggy bank.

Look, I get it. Times are tough thanks to Joe Biden's Economy and our team doesn't want to pressure you towards donating if you can't afford it.

You will never receive a solicitation from this campaign that promises a fake match or degrades you for not donating.

No smoke and mirrors, no fake matches, and no lies.

**Meet Ron DeSantis**
---

---
| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he graduated with honors and was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School. While at Harvard, he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer. During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq as an adviser to a U.S. Navy SEAL commander in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a federal prosecutor, where he targeted and convicted child predators. He was elected to Congress in 2012 and advocated for congressional term limits and a balanced budget amendment. Hoosier Republican, In our latest session recap, we’re continuing to _cut through the noise,_ highlighting some of what was accomplished in the 2023 legislative session. Today, we’re telling you everything you need to know about how Governor Eric Holcomb and statehouse Republicans took steps to **build stronger communities across the state**.
---
[**HELP US CONTINUE TO DELIVER RESULTS**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/3581fe9f80103f6b/e4314ce594782c1fc3d6b838967d376c/40313)

You’ve probably heard a lot about READI — the Regional Economic Acceleration and Development Initiative — and for good reason. To date, the program has **leveraged over** **$8.5 billion in quality of life and place investments across the state**. So, to further help communities catalyze growth and undertake transformational projects, the Republican-led legislature funded **READI 2.0.** But that’s not all. This session, the legislature also took action that will: 🥾 Expand the state’s trails system. 🖼️ Conserve more of Indiana’s great outdoors. ✈️ Allow Indiana to pursue more direct flights from North America’s No. 1 airport — the Indianapolis International Airport. 🛃 Help regional airports undertake important upgrades. 🥫 Expand the state’s food bank network. **Strong communities help build a strong Indiana.** And thanks to Governor Holcomb and the Republican-led legislature, Indiana will only get stronger. | Peter, Would you be OK if your child's school library promoted sexually explicit books? **_Of course you wouldn't be._** Anyone with common sense would find the above to be wildly inappropriate, especially in a public school setting. Two brave Roxbury moms, Kristen Cobo and Christina Balestriere, became aware of a multitude of sexually explicit, vulgar books available to minor children in their public school district, and decided to do something about it. When Kristen and Christina continued to speak up at school board meetings to exercise their First Amendment Right to petition to government at a public forum, **_the school librarian sued._** **FOR DEFAMATION.** The librarian's husband is an attorney, so she is not paying legal fees. This frivolous lawsuit is an attempt to silence parents who stand up to question whether books with graphic sexual content should be promoted to children.

Hello Friend,

A lot of campaigns are urging you to donate before their self-constructed fundraising deadlines. They're probably making you feel terrible if you don't contribute too, aren't they?

At Team DeSantis we're taking a different approach.

Our entire fundraising & digital program's foundation is built on this principle: Our donors are a part of our team; they are NOT our personal piggy bank.

Look, I get it. Times are tough thanks to Joe Biden's Economy and our team doesn't want to pressure you towards donating if you can't afford it.

You will never receive a solicitation from this campaign that promises a fake match or degrades you for not donating.

No smoke and mirrors, no fake matches, and no lies.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq as an adviser to a U.S. Navy SEAL commander in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.

Congressman DeSantis was also a leading champion for America's veterans and helped enact reforms to the VA and place an emphasis on mental health.

Friend, This week, Congress must raise the country’s debt ceiling so the government can keep paying its bills and avoid economic catastrophe. Hi there, it’s New York Senator Kirsten Gillibrand.
I’m reaching out today on behalf of my friend Gabby Giffords. Tonight, her organization GIFFORDS PAC is facing its May fundraising deadline.
[**It would mean so much to both of us if you could contribute $3 or any amount that makes sense for you to GIFFORDS PAC before their monthly deadline passes.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-may23.Jtluwk&refcode=em230531-1-15&t=2&akid=5807%2E3935704%2EQ-rZsF)
I am proud to say that Gabby and I have been friends for nearly two decades. We met as freshmen Congresswomen back in 2006. In a male-dominated House of Representatives, we bonded over our shared values and commitment to public service.
After she was shot in 2011, I have seen Gabby persevere through every stage of her remarkable recovery. Her drive to keep fighting, even on her hardest days, has served as an inspiration to me and countless others. She brings this same determination to her work in keeping our communities safe from gun violence.
I’m proud to support GIFFORDS, a leader in the movement to end gun violence in our nation. The organization’s research and advocacy are so important for lawmakers like me who are working to enact commonsense lifesaving gun safety legislation.
[**So friends, can I count on you to contribute to GIFFORDS PAC and help them close their fundraising gap before their May fundraising deadline passes at midnight?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-may23.Jtluwk&refcode=em230531-1-15&t=3&akid=5807%2E3935704%2EQ-rZsF)

“I am endorsing Carmen because she believes in America and its people!” | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/973993c03552/im-announcing-my-run-for-us-congress-in-the-8th-congressional-district-13551203?e=0e51d1e991)
---

---
| | Peter,
---
| **I’m delighted to announce that Utah Attorney General Sean Reyes has endorsed my candidacy to serve Washingtonians in Congress!**

AG Reyes’ has a proven record of defending the Constitutional rights of his constituents, even in the face of federal government overreach.
---
| [ ](https://mcshanellc.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ac7c5348d309f6a3d3cffd39b&id=e7dc71fa71&e=0e51d1e991)
---
| **Attorney General Reyes shared the following statement: **

_"I am proud to endorse my friend Carmen Goers for Congress in Washington's 8th Congressional District. I am endorsing Carmen because she believes in America and its people! From her experience as a banker, a community leader, a mother of three and her time with the Department of Defense, I know that she will work hard to make her communities safe. I applaud Carmen as she fights for our right to pursue a life of liberty and happiness."_

_**I am deeply honored to receive this endorsement from Attorney General Reyes**_. The people of Utah are safer now with a prosecutor who will stand up against Big Government, while also upholding the rule of law against drug dealers, human traffickers, child predators, and white-collar criminals.

I’m grateful for AG Reyes’ recognition of my determination to make Washington communities safer, and that I will be a defender of the individual rights which have inspired a nation of freedom-loving people to achieve the American Dream.

When the people of Washington send me to Congress, I look forward to taking a bold stand for the rule of law and its equal application so that our children and grandchildren grow up in a society where responsibility and accountability are the norm for all, not the exception!

**Peter, the DC Uniparty would prefer to call the shots on which laws apply to who.** [**Supporting my stand for the equal application of the law with even $15 today will fortify my efforts to triumph as a Congresswoman of We The People!**](https://mcshanellc.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ac7c5348d309f6a3d3cffd39b&id=a1ae629baa&e=0e51d1e991)

AG Reyes’ has a proven record of defending the Constitutional rights of his constituents, even in the face of federal government overreach. | | Attorney General Reyes shared the following statement: "I am proud to endorse my friend Carmen Goers for Congress in Washington's 8th Congressional District. I am endorsing Carmen because she believes in America and its people! From her experience as a banker, a community leader, a mother of three and her time with the Department of Defense, I know that she will work hard to make her communities safe. I applaud Carmen as she fights for our right to pursue a life of liberty and happiness." I am deeply honored to receive this endorsement from Attorney General Reyes. The people of Utah are safer now with a prosecutor who will stand up against Big Government, while also upholding the rule of law against drug dealers, human traffickers, child predators, and white-collar criminals. I’m grateful for AG Reyes’ recognition of my determination to make Washington communities safer, and that I will be a defender of the individual rights which have inspired a nation of freedom-loving people to achieve the American Dream. When the people of Washington send me to Congress, I look forward to taking a bold stand for the rule of law and its equal application so that our children and grandchildren grow up in a society where responsibility and accountability are the norm for all, not the exception! Peter, the DC Uniparty would prefer to call the shots on which laws apply to who. | "ENDORSE GOERS FOR CONGRESS" | "CONTRIBUTE TODAY" | For Washington, | | Carmen Goers Candidate for U.S. Congress, WA-8 | | | | | | | | | | | | "Paid for by Carmen for Congress" | | Copyright © 2023 Carmen for Congress, All rights reserved.

# **From Vision to Reality**
---
|
---
**Running for office may seem like a daunting task, but we have identified five key attributes that are crucial for a successful campaign:**
1. **Compassion:** A successful candidate understands the needs and concerns of their constituents. They approach every interaction with empathy, compassion, and a genuine desire to improve the lives of those they serve.

2. **Listening Skills:** Effective leaders listen attentively and actively to their constituents, even when they hold opposing views. By genuinely listening and engaging in thoughtful dialogue, you can build trust and find common ground to address community issues.

3. **Authenticity:** Being true to yourself and your values is essential. Voters appreciate candidates who are authentic and transparent, allowing them to connect with you on a personal level and trust your intentions.

4. **Strong Work Ethic:** Running for office requires dedication, hard work, and perseverance. A successful campaign involves grassroots organizing, fundraising, and community outreach. Your commitment and determination will inspire others and demonstrate your genuine desire to serve.

5. **Collaboration:** Successful candidates understand the importance of collaboration and coalition-building. By working with diverse groups and stakeholders, you can build a strong network of supporters and work towards common goals for the betterment of your community.

At Our Time To Run, we believe that the future of America is in your hands. We want to help you find your voice, and we want to give you the tools you need to make that voice heard.

| | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z8luk2tdesfje7cb4hnq1d3vm2l4letaqttrs64o_rp22sh2s8i66o75clhmcor0slh2bs)

Hello, Revisionists would have you believe that our founders intended for a complete separation between Church and State and that Christianity should be absent from all aspects of our government. However, the reality is quite different. Our nation was founded on Christian principles, and the founders wanted our government to uphold those principles.

I’ve written a book whose title boldly declares what I know to be true: _America Is a Christian Nation_. Many would dispute that claim, but my book provides evidence for this truth using the very words and actions of the founders themselves. The book is a short read, accompanied by beautiful patriotic photos that I think you’ll appreciate.

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
subject: This makes a lot of classist, ageist, misogynist, and racist people mad.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Alexandria is the youngest woman in U.S. history to be elected to Congress. She was a waitress. She is Latina. She comes from a low-income background and is one of just a few working-class people elected to Congress.
That makes a lot of classist, ageist, misogynist, and racist people mad.
But together with your support, we’ve built a movement fighting for transformative change — from Medicare for All to democratizing fundraising power in politics.
[If you’d like to help support our movement, could you donate $3 or anything you can afford right now to help us reach our $400,000 end-of-month fundraising goal before midnight tonight?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230531-1.DZitrO&refcode=em20230531-4411-P_FND_EOM_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4411%2E2526796%2EEUsRxY)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230531-1.DZitrO&refcode=em20230531-4411-P_FND_EOM_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=4411%2E2526796%2EEUsRxY)**
AOC and our movement are often labeled “extreme.” Here’s what they think makes us extreme:
* AOC believes in Medicare for All, aka guaranteed healthcare in the United States.
* AOC operates independently from either party’s establishment. So she is willing to challenge Democratic Party leadership and, when necessary, break from the party line.
* Our movement does not believe in late stage capitalism or that prioritizing the extreme pursuit of profit at any and all human/environmental costs will save us. AOC believes in cooperative economics and cooperative democracy, aka democratic socialism.

This campaign is funded by grassroots, small-dollar donations and AOC accepts $0 in corporate money (the average donation to this campaign is around $16).
[ If you believe in fighting for a brighter future for all, please contribute $3 today to help us reach our $400,000 end-of-month fundraising goal before midnight tonight.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230531-1.DZitrO&refcode=em20230531-4411-P_FND_EOM_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=4411%2E2526796%2EEUsRxY)
Thank you so much for your support,
Team AOC

Can I explain something, folks?
I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents.
In fact, I’m very proud to be the only U.S. Senator who manages a full-time job outside the Senate — as a farmer .
Every spring, I spend weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive.
I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand.
The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy — but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded.
And rather than spend my days hobnobbing with Republican special interests, I rely on hard-working folks like you to power everything we do.
That’s why I’m personally asking you to join my reelection team and split $15 between Seth Moulton and my campaign today to help us block Mitch McConnell from taking back the Senate. Anything you can give makes a difference. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-tester]
Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-tester]
Thank you so much for sticking by me. I promise to spend every ounce of time fighting for you and your families (when I’m not out in the field, of course).
— Jon

Hi friend – Laura Friedman here.

Transparency is very important to me, so I’m reaching out today to give you a peek under the hood of our campaign.

Our finance team has been closely tracking our fundraising numbers, and as of now, we have about $6,000 left to raise before midnight to hit our end-of-month goal for May. Can I count on you to use the link below to give $5 and help us make up ground?

**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lf-q2-2023?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/64111132/409024404/62647395?refcode=em-5.31.23-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjRiNWFhYzUtZDBmZi1lZDExLTkwN2MtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=nMtZNwCFrV1dAL4fQi3wOiSNsLt41etuGG3WucfZ6GI=)**

Look, it’s very important that we don’t fall short of our goal, and here’s why:

I’m the most viable progressive woman in the race for CA-30. Our district is a Democratic stronghold, and I’ve been on the front lines of all the major progressive fights we’ve faced in the Assembly and in local office. I’ll bring my experience with me.

However, our campaign is being out-raised by three other candidates. If we don’t pick up the pace now, we could cede the momentum we’ve worked so hard to build through our incredible local support.

I’m so proud to be running a corporate PAC-free campaign, but that means we’re reliant on the support we get from emails like this one. Anything you can afford to chip in will go a long way.

Here’s that donation link again: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lf-q2-2023?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/64111133/409024405/62647395?refcode=em-5.31.23-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjRiNWFhYzUtZDBmZi1lZDExLTkwN2MtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=nMtZNwCFrV1dAL4fQi3wOiSNsLt41etuGG3WucfZ6GI=)**

Thank you for considering it – and for all you do for this movement.

Onward,

Laura

Los Angeles, CA 90027

subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsxQFhaDNC

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital
to our nation's future.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osxQFhaDNC

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent
matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but
the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by
progressives-but supported by many well-meaning Americans-to
change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do
away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our
Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a
National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to
me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more
clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning
this issue-views we will make available to policymakers and
opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on
Presidential Selection by using the link below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61866541:sxQFhaDNC:m:3:2532013465:FA1537F97ACD80951D6648D4EE5DAA61:r

For most of our nation's history, the
Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution,
was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to
preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have
joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional
bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution
has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to
provide young people with a proper grounding in American
civics-too many Americans simply don't understand the importance
of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has
expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide,
directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the
Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide
through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The
Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and
businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of
liberty;

Promoting constitutional education
through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of
America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across
America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by
helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide
and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical
K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of
American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on
Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most
effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the
importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the
importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this
critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent
topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection
and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a
few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure
link I've provided below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61866541:sxQFhaDNC:m:3:2532013465:FA1537F97ACD80951D6648D4EE5DAA61:r

And after you take your survey, I hope you
will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a
tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing
truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its
extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept
ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form
of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is
essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the
National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for
your time and attention-and for your friendship and support of
liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

Even though we know DACA is right and lawful, DACA does not define us. Regardless of what the outcome of this court case is, we are here to stay.
Right now, DACA is only open to current recipients who are allowed to continue renewing their status. The program has been closed to new applicants for 2 years, ever since Judge Hanen first ruled against DACA.
But DACA could soon be in jeopardy for everyone as anti-immigrant judges and Republican politicians continue their crusade to shut down the program forever.
**That’s why we need permanent protections NOW. And that’s why United We Dream Action is ramping up our advocacy work.**
We’ve led Weeks of Action to make our demands for citizenship undeniable to leaders in Washington, DC. We’ve driven phone calls, emails, and text messages to members of Congress to demand they take action. And we’ve even secured meetings at the White House to explain the urgency of this moment.
With another court decision on the DACA program looming, we’ll need your support to keep up our fight.

subject: Thank you, Congressman Cicilline!
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/105455/images/Gabe%20Amo%20Header_V6.png]

Friend,

Today is Congressman Cicilline's last day in the United States Congress. I want to thank him for his tireless work in fighting for all Americans, Rhode Islanders, and the First Congressional District.

As he said in his final speech on the House floor, Congressman Cicilline truly “left it all on the field” in his service to our state.

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/105455/images/Thank%20you%2C%20Congressman%20Cicilline%21%20%281%29.png]

In Congress, David Cicilline has been a fierce advocate for the people of Rhode Island and fundamental freedoms in our country – protecting democracy, pushing hard for common sense gun legislation, holding the tech industry accountable, and leading the charge on LGBTQIA+ equality.

As your Representative in Congress, I will carry on Congressman Cicilline’s legacy – standing up to extremists, fighting to protect our rights, and bringing resources home to Rhode Island.
Sign your name [https://secure.ngpvan.com/_40G3Fwug0mopWw5vA1LvQ2] to thank Congressman Cicilline for his years of service.

Gabe Amo

**This week we commemorated the collapse of the Skagit River Bridge.** On the evening of May 23, 2013 a large truck traveling south on I-5 clipped the frame of the bridge and caused a span of the bridge to collapse into the river.
We were blessed that no one died or was injured in the collapse of the bridge. But in a heartbreaking accident eight days later, a Washington State Patrol Trooper, Sean O'Connell Jr., was killed while directing traffic in the aftermath of the bridge collapse.
**The collapse of the Skagit River Bridge and the accident that took the life of Trooper O'Connell remind us how important infrastructure investment is to the safety and prosperity of our communities.**
Bridges should not collapse. Our officers should not be needlessly in harm's way. **Our communities should not suffer like this. That is why I work so hard to ensure we invest in the infrastructure of our communities.**
Whether that is the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law I helped pass, my work with local leaders and tax payers to improve our infrastructure, or my daily work as ranking member of the Infrastructure Committee;**I am committed to improving our infrastructure and keeping our communities safe.**
The strength of our community and our grassroots involvement are the reasons I can do the hard work of legislating in Congress.
Together we can improve our community. Together we can build a better future. But only together.
_Rick_
