name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: Will you pledge to be a servant leader for our great nation?
body:
As you and I know – our freedoms are under attack.

|
---
| | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zvjku6qv3dtasobi5dvmrqe6ob2g4mmpg2ht52n0_rp22sh2s8i66o75clhm6o72cjh2bs)
---
| Dear Fellow Patriot,

As you and I know - our freedoms are under attack.

They are under attack from our fellow citizens who see this country and her people as irredeemable.

They are under attack from leaders in government, media, and education who serve only one interest: their own interest. [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zk84ubqufg3uu2go5ek0i26v63ihhf6dbsceqmd8_rp22sh2s8i66o75clhm6o72cjh2bs)
These people hold the most dangerous, most extreme, most anti-American beliefs. They have taken more-and-more power away from the people... they are asserting more-and-more control over us.

They tax us, they regulate us, they silence us, they punish us, they remove opportunities from us, they weaken us, and they indoctrinate our children.

It is up to us to rise above as servant leaders committed to upholding the principles that inspired America.

We must set an example as faithful leaders and unite our fellow Americans in an effort to preserve our freedom.

We must be willing to sacrifice, to fight for our freedoms, to not just envision - but to ensure - a strong, prosperous, great America for our grandchildren.

Because if not us, then who will do it? Who will lead?

Today, I'm hoping that you'll pledge your commitment as a servant leader for our great nation.

If you're up to the challenge to help preserve our founding principles and lead our country in the direction of freedom, please sign the pledge via this secure link: [https://offers.americancornerstone.org/servant-leader-card-pledge/](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zfflpj0nv7n7a50okvk8csj5hef67b3ddpt3bak8_rp22sh2s8i66o75clhm6o72cjh2bs)

It's your sweat, your sacrifice, and your service to others, and to God that inspire me day after day. This effort will return our country to its beacon of hope and freedom.

Sincerely,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chariman
American Cornerstone Institute

subject: ICYMI: My end-of-month deadline matters. Here’s why
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Karen Greenhalgh for Delegate
body:

---
| | Hey there- I know you get a million of these “fundraising deadline” emails every month, but I’m hoping you read this one all the way through. End-of month deadlines are actually important for a few reasons.
1. I have to raise a certain amount of money each month to ensure we meet our expenses and continue to grow our campaign!
2. Any campaign that’s looking to spread awareness usually needs to book advertising space in advance. My finance team tells me how much I need to raise by the end of each month if I’m going to plan advertising campaigns.
3. My district is going to be a huge target for Virginia Democrats this fall. I need to raise funds now so I’m prepared to respond when the attacks come.

So here’s the deal: I need to raise another $2,300 by TONIGHT at midnight (5/31), and I’m really hoping you can help. I know $2,300 doesn’t seem like a lot for a campaign, but trust me - it will go a LONG way in keeping things afloat for the next 30 days.
Being your delegate has been one of my life’s greatest honors, and I hope to continue my work of lowering taxes, supporting our veterans, and cutting crime after the election this fall. With that said:**[Can you help chip in so I can meet my May fundraising goal?](http://sendpatriot.campstrategic.com/go/1/23a9f17af7861f4f16f79d307c796b93/37923/6b3769118fbdc6d6/b693284f6e46fa37c3d6b838967d376c/37923)** Thank you!

However, the reality is quite different. Our nation was founded on Christian principles, and the founders wanted our government to uphold those principles.

I've written a book whose title boldly declares what I know to be true: _America Is a Christian Nation_. Many would dispute that claim, but my book provides evidence for this truth using the very words and actions of the founders themselves. The book is a short read, accompanied by beautiful patriotic photos that I think you'll appreciate.

I’ve said it before and I’ll say it again: I am the perfect villain for the far-right: I’m gay, I’m an immigrant, I’ve been a leader in fighting the pandemic, and now I am publicly holding lawmakers accountable.**

But I know with you by my side, we can combat that corporate dark money and the right-wing attacks that could come our way. So I’m asking:

Robert Garcia

The Goldwater Institute is working with former California teacher Kali Fontanilla to _expose the lies of Critical Race Theory and remove woke radicalism in the classroom_.

**The Goldwater Institute has successfully challenged unconstitutional laws, regulations, and policies that threaten our freedoms and limit our opportunities.**

Friends, I know your inbox is likely flooded with requests from candidates today, so I’ll keep this brief - and I hope you’ll read the whole thing.
I’m running for re-election to the House of Representatives because I believe that the people of California’s 51st District - and every single American - deserve a leader they can trust to look out for their interests.
In a divided government - and a divided country - trust is a rare commodity. But at the end of the day, it’s the only thing that matters in this business.
If you can’t trust me to have your back - to vote against legislation that will harm you and your loved ones, to put forth and fight for legislation that will help you thrive - then what are we even doing here?
I hope I’ve earned your trust over the past three years.
If I have, I hope you’ll consider supporting my re-election campaign with a small donation - $5, $10, or whatever is meaningful to you would make a big difference in our efforts.

My name is Fred Guttenberg. Since losing my daughter, Jaime, in the Parkland school shooting over five years ago, I’ve dedicated my life to trying to prevent more gun violence tragedies in America.

**That’s why I need to talk to you about Annie’s new organization, Their Future PAC, and the work they’re doing to tackle the problems our kids are facing.**

**_[First, though, I need to ask you to join me by contributing $10 to this organization that I am so proud to support.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953w_lFHxeGZje-SUFN05SFbCcYUzzBshfAMuBYDM1HdZO5obqZh7Akb3izetiMv71SfvANJpsDU6TQCHcAQDy3NKeDY1UklgeZBlhPhnObKGItpCD0RGdjXy0z3mTVvPpnslvWyFrOhQaaAqvWx0a56wpWFKl6w1ugiqwFKR_McZyajZHTCW_GV3ObGdlGzkNe0n44q7Ape13D3-Wv3yEA_gTN8TGhCq-2dT3hJkuIejczpY9pRNG9PoGC4yNKJ-_Jr5AFp1zi_s8L_Aqcz0n7z0v4eG4mgbS_XtsFxBV-Crht-KxGp2H80McyVwf9YWodP9v_30_WNoRYiwZiMqQlKGPj6XUhV8maR6iYx0MiNUxaV1zFZhw5o582jC_YpEIJdwHlPjbaxPRx4RkQr_9Jj2/3wn/xdsLF3geRnmBoAdTDTOFkw/h1/Gxush9ELtjtZiwJouGL_VG8Hyhqte0VgLmz5dDfr7WI)_**

Annie is a fierce advocate for common sense gun laws because, as a pediatrician, she knows that gun violence is the leading cause of childhood death in America and has seen kids with bullet wounds too many times in her hospital.

While I was saddened that her congressional campaign did not succeed, I am proud she’s not giving up the fight. In 2022, she saw the appetite folks have for action, and with Their Future PAC, is putting everything she has into affecting real change.

Her new organization is dedicated to ending the stress of mass shootings in our schools, as well as combating the climate crisis, making healthcare more affordable, and strengthening our democracy. I’m putting my support behind Their Future PAC and I’m asking you to as well.

**_[Their next budget deadline is Friday and we need your help to ensure Annie has all the support she needs to create the change our children deserve.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953w_lFHxeGZje-SUFN05SFbCcYUzzBshfAMuBYDM1HdZO5obqZh7Akb3izetiMv71SfvANJpsDU6TQCHcAQDy3NKeDY1UklgeZBlhPhnObKGItpCD0RGdjXy0z3mTVvPpnskbr0VnMCZA5ae9_9aiQpHQhEJoBWTXGxu9pv5hWGhfmWb19j3BMkvcbBfDnhvm7zqaFEZAmgYlOKoPAUqUC4nWdhI6_VrysSPd_Ppeoj8UJWljyHJgcohzCema9ZpN6nTYwrGI5lpI7hvL7Cx04QIwXDkM30J4YqxF2DMGHxrW3Weub9N2BlsLjYjFPcHd3Dl8D64A1jJTgAoKz66dJGsX9g0QnlUibHHabSnMilS1KHAdHjAKp5flGT_NKhQS3swVvrNizL0hwyDyRMEaFbI/3wn/xdsLF3geRnmBoAdTDTOFkw/h2/KtUmJFbRhD_t_ETpHM-36Wju6V6NmySxOBHoGxe9gqE)_**

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight."
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That's why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **" Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry." **
Through** "Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,"** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** ** ** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

Friend,

Senator Sherrod Brown has spent his career on the frontlines fighting for working families and rural communities—fair wages, good jobs, and affordable healthcare. **Friend, I’m running for re-election in one of the most competitive seats in the entire country, and the GOP is already spending money against me.[In a moment, I’m going to ask you to make a contribution to our end-of-month fundraising goal. But if you don’t have time to read this email right now, can you please chip in before you click away?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/64118707/409050833/373057073?refcode=em_fr_2023.05.31_b1_as_all-nd&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzOTllZWFjMS1kZmZmLWVkMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=B6Uf_dRUXyw9UCkNs3zMN2bjyiGtS9lqz1FgRH7zpNw=)** My dad immigrated to the U.S. from Mexico in 1950. He believed in the power of hard work to make a difference. He worked in the fields, served two tours in Vietnam, and took a union job to provide a path into the middle class for our family. While we didn’t have a lot growing up, my family believed that through hard work, you can achieve anything. It took me seven years to graduate college – and I juggled multiple jobs, from painting houses to pouring coffee – but I put in the hard work and earned that degree. My daughter was born 18 years ago, and my family’s hard work gave me the determination that I needed to leave the world a better place for her. That’s why I stepped up to join the Oregon legislature. As a state legislator, I fought for more affordable health care, helped Oregon begin to tackle our climate crisis, and passed the nation’s most progressive paid family leave bill. **It takes hard work to get these things done, but I was determined.** **I’ve brought that same level of determination to Washington. name: Al Canata
subject: Is the American Dream dead?
body:
People today are finding it more and more difficult to reach the milestones we used to take for granted.

[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=632c695f7e3548889751069853760c06&_e=SosR4YmYnB8GaPrERt88UZjeJDimX6kJP9vbDMcBikAzW9aH_yIQhIJDqJEX-W17okUm3GxmMQKmlepjxBT9aMDEP5SN48zMYx_sNbYXFHm9zTxv2NYfdHn6ecxqHx1f-_cEzvnVQEM0zT-NMJvm3lCNCBVjdYHSfgQworXlBl9_fPZ5uGqBuEcEOMDSjfQ_gQSqL55xUZG9u3tSQL4smIddCL_SopF2iv-P231prThluoDbx1jOYby1u_FVL-d4ZSyuyUoNnDft5_3SWz4cfAS7-AmM-6GOBOSPLbsiwHI%3D)

Friend,

People today are finding it more and more difficult to reach the milestones we used to take for granted. Buying a house, raising a family, or even starting a small business.

And thanks to unsustainable federal spending and increasing debt levels, the American Dream seems further and further out of reach for future generations.

_**But is the American Dream dead?**_

No, but we do not have much time before Washington's debt (and higher taxes because of debt) will consume American productivity and make it nearly impossible for anyone to succeed.

_**The good news?**_

National Taxpayers Union (NTU) is on Capitol Hill now fighting for you, small businesses, and all taxpayers. Our team of lobbyists is known as the "Voice of America's Taxpayers," and we have been behind every major taxpayer victory in the last five decades.

I am Al Canata, Vice President of Strategic Partnerships at the National Taxpayers Union. NTU is working to persuade Congress to support debt reduction and reduce spending so that tomorrow's generation won't face crushing tax burdens or lower living standards.

**You can help NTU keep up the pressure in Washington to stop kicking the can down the road and take action. Our goal is to raise $50,000 before the end of this month.** [Can you send an urgent donation of $100, $35, or even $10 today to ramp up the pressure on Congress? Click here to donate >>](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=632c695f7e3548889751069853760c06&_e=SosR4YmYnB8GaPrERt88UZjeJDimX6kJP9vbDMcBikAzW9aH_yIQhIJDqJEX-W17okUm3GxmMQKmlepjxBT9aMDEP5SN48zMYx_sNbYXFHm9zTxv2NYfdHn6ecxqHx1f-_cEzvnVQEM0zT-NMJvm3uSBrm9kIVX-eYXlEFC5DbxkKPhTniOe5eTDPMhxjJbNFQhbPKjU_-oHA2Qpc2AB8RqGWo-OxjRW22aQsQ_ZvDb0fprlPU4Z4tfvvS8MtnU5-GoGmgeuHy76guszpJcCD1GhbMMbYkWObNW435MOsdU%3D)

That's a choice we have to make today. So let me tell you what we're up against.

**The Congressional Budget Office (CBO) projects that under current law, the federal government will add more than $19 TRILLION to debt held by the public over the next decade alone,_an 80% increase_ from current debt levels.**

And the trust funds for the nation's two largest spending programs, _Social Security and Medicare Part A are projected to be insolvent in 2035 and 2028_ , respectively.

Legislation to increase federal spending (including defense spending) has been a primary driver of higher projected deficits. Another primary driver of increasing deficits is rising interest costs to service the federal government's existing debt. And, of course, we can't overlook government social programs too.

**Almost one in every five dollars collected by the federal government is being diverted to paying interest on existing debt.**

Debt growth continues to outpace economic growth, reaching 100% of GDP next fiscal year and reaching a record 118% of GDP by the end of the decade.

There are significant negative consequences for American families, businesses, and taxpayers in allowing America to continue on its unsustainable fiscal trajectory.

And that's just the beginning.

A number of potential policy choices could increase deficits, debt, and/or net interest costs even further in the decade to come!

Whatever debt ceiling deadline Congress is dealing with now, the next deadline after this one will likely come sooner than lawmakers think.

[Please make an urgent donation to help NTU advocate for taxpayers, _Click here to donate today_ _and help us raise $50,000 before the end of the month._](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=632c695f7e3548889751069853760c06&_e=SosR4YmYnB8GaPrERt88UZjeJDimX6kJP9vbDMcBikAzW9aH_yIQhIJDqJEX-W17okUm3GxmMQKmlepjxBT9aMDEP5SN48zMYx_sNbYXFHm9zTxv2NYfdHn6ecxqHx1f-_cEzvnVQEM0zT-NMJvm3mp0hq_EMZUCggLlg9G--xYJAxXQ2knkY5QQ7HimXKh2krlLq3TrERTf0hOw323_fpCo4W-aQePc64WSyNaJ93wMHZSEd5Fg7EV1oAmyzrdLm96zbUSpdaRb5a8O68zooE9yUYzFTV9pb_KzHIiE_fU%3D)

There is a long, long history of attaching debt ceiling increases or suspensions to legislation that includes other fiscal, spending, or policy reforms.

That's where NTU comes in!

We're working in the halls of Congress to get out-of-control spending back under control by implementing reforms including but not limited to:
* Tighter restrictions on emergency spending and overseas military spending to restrict lawmakers' efforts to circumvent discretionary spending caps.

* A broader "sequester" to increase lawmakers' incentives to reach a special committee agreement on deficit reduction and enact that package into law.

* Legislation that would limit government spending growth in future years to a "primary balance factor" that is based in large part on the nation's annual GDP growth rate.

NTU stands ready to guide Congress toward meaningful reforms that have won support across the ideological spectrum.

We have played a major role in signature taxpayer victories over the past five decades. We helped overhaul the federal tax code under President Reagan in 1986. We championed the cause for a "Taxpayer Bill of Rights" in the late 80s and 90s. And most recently, in 2017, NTU was the driving force behind the successful push for comprehensive tax reform.

Now I need your help to raise $50,000 before the end of the month. Your generous support will impact our efforts in this next phase of the debt limit battle.

The consequences for American families, businesses, and taxpayers are too great for us to ignore.

Please support NTU's fight in Congress by donating any amount you can generously send today

body:
Together, we’ve been fighting and organizing to build a democracy that works and supports everyone.
#
Peter, today is the last day of our May fundraising push!
When we reached out yesterday afternoon, we still had $2,344 left to raise to close the gap on our goal. **And as of this morning, we're just $1,002 away from the finish line.**
[**Peter, no matter the size of your donation, your support _will_ make an impact. Can we count on you to chip in $5, $10, $50, or whatever you're able to give to help us reach our goal before midnight tonight? **](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/42274?source=em20230531-2546&t=1&akid=2546%2E420207%2Eo0-yUu)
**[Donate](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/42274?refcode=em20230531-2546&t=20&akid=2546%2E420207%2Eo0-yUu)**
**May was a momentous month for Pramila and our campaign.** And that's thanks to your continued support and faith in our vision to build a just and equitable democracy.
Pramila took to Congress every day to fight for critical legislation, stand up to Big Pharma, and challenge extreme MAGA Republicans. She has amplified our collective call to reinstill trust and honor in the highest courts in America, and made sure to call out bad actors who use their power for _their own_ special interests — _not_ to support their constituents.
All the while, she's been a fearless advocate to protect trans children and LGBTQ+ communities in light of the far-right's witch hunts.
Together, we've been fighting and organizing to build a democracy that works and supports everyone. Still, the GOP insists on leading us towards millions of lost jobs, trillions in wiped-out wealth, and a dried-up trade market. We can no longer allow these politicians to gamble with the livelihoods of working people.
**The only way we'll be able to see the change we deserve is by working together to keep Pramila fighting for us in Congress.**[**Chip in today to help us close the gap on our fundraising goal before midnight tonight.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/42274?source=em20230531-2546&t=21&akid=2546%2E420207%2Eo0-yUu)
In solidarity,
Team Jayapal

name: Maxwell Frost
subject: Do you have a moment?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| [**Friend, thank you for being a part of our people-powered movement. This email is long, but I hope you’ll read it and consider making a direct contribution to the Voter Protection Project.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/46377?t=6&akid=8000%2E878179%2ELv0Db6) | [CONTRIBUTE $10 NOW »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/46377?t=7&akid=8000%2E878179%2ELv0Db6)
---
As an activist, I’ve dedicated my life to advocating for justice and equality. Now, I am running for re-election in Congress to ensure that every voice is heard, every vote is counted, and every citizen's right to vote is protected.

Democracy's heart lies in the right to vote. But it pains me deeply to witness the systemic barriers that prevent people from exercising this basic right. We can’t ignore the injustices that disenfranchise marginalized people and prevent them from having their voices heard to influence the direction of our country.

**I’m talking about people like my barber,** a hardworking and resilient person who, two decades ago, committed a crime driven by desperation. Despite serving his sentence, turning his life around, and successfully building his own business, he is unable to vote because of a felony conviction from his past.

His story isn't unique. This ruthless system that silences America’s most vulnerable in our electoral process? It isn’t an accident. _It's all by design._ Republicans who benefit from voter suppression and maintaining the status quo will throw endless amounts of dark money to squash any chance of progress.

That’s why as a Congressman, I'm fighting to ensure that every citizen—regardless of their past or background—can participate in our democracy. **I’m committed to this fight because, without voting rights, it’ll be impossible to safeguard our Democratic values, leaving abortion rights, gender equality, and social security vulnerable to being stripped away by Republicans.**

[**But fighting Republican voter suppression will take a collective effort. By making a direct contribution to the Voter Protection Project, you're investing in an organization whose sole purpose is to elect Democrats like me who are committed to fending off Republican voter suppression tactics. Can I count on your contribution today?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/46377?t=8&akid=8000%2E878179%2ELv0Db6)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
[CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/46383?t=9&akid=8000%2E878179%2ELv0Db6)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/46379?t=10&akid=8000%2E878179%2ELv0Db6)
[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/46380?t=11&akid=8000%2E878179%2ELv0Db6)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/46381?t=12&akid=8000%2E878179%2ELv0Db6)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/46382?t=13&akid=8000%2E878179%2ELv0Db6)
From the bottom of my heart, thank you.
[](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/46377?t=14&akid=8000%2E878179%2ELv0Db6)
—Maxwell Frost

The Voter Protection Project is on an important mission: To end partisan gerrymandering and voter suppression by electing candidates at the state and federal levels that are forceful advocates for voting rights. Our enfranchisement agenda includes working to ensure that every state has automatic voter registration and online voter registration, convenient early voting, and independent redistricting commissions to ensure politicians are not able to draw their own maps.

Please, consider making a [one-time contribution by clicking here](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/121?t=1&akid=8000%2E878179%2ELv0Db6). **Or, to make the most powerful lasting impact and help us oust Republicans up and down the ballot who attack our right to vote, make a[monthly sustaining contribution by clicking here](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/122?t=2&akid=8000%2E878179%2ELv0Db6).**

Listen – tonight at midnight is the cutoff for our end-of-month fundraising push. We have a big goal to meet to stay on track to flip this seat and replace Lauren Boebert with a congresswoman who’ll put the people of western and southern Colorado first.
I’m not a millionaire from Aspen. I’m a mom and a veterinarian, and I run a small agricultural business with my husband.
But I’m running for Congress because we need more folks like me – who know what it’s like to have to work to pay our bills – in the halls of power.
If you agree, then I hope you will chip in $25 or whatever you can by midnight. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2305_q2_mayeom?refcode2=link_CTA1]
Here’s a personalized link to give: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2305_q2_mayeom?refcode2=128525838 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2305_q2_mayeom?refcode2=128525838]
I won’t mince words. This won’t be an easy race. Lauren Boebert is a right-wing extremist who puts the interests of her dark money donors ahead of those of the families of our district. She even refused to vote for the bipartisan debt limit deal.
Democrats came incredibly close to replacing her last cycle, and I know our team has what it takes to finish the job this time.
But we need everyone to do their part to make it happen, and that means we can’t miss this goal.
You can give right now with this personalized link: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2305_q2_mayeom?refcode2=128525838 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2305_q2_mayeom?refcode2=128525838]
Thanks for all you do,
Debby
Dr. Debby Burnett is running to represent Colorado’s 3rd District in Congress. As a veterinarian of 20+ years, she’s worked with farmers and ranchers across our district to improve their lives and their livelihoods. As the mother of a 16-year-old, she knows how to get 20 things done at once. And as a rural Coloradan who owns a small agricultural business, she understands what the people of western and southern Colorado need — and that’s why she’s stepping up to give them a real voice in Congress.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

**WHAT WE’RE UP AGAINST **
* Historically, special election turnout is well below the average turnout for regularly scheduled primary and general elections. We’ll have to work twice as hard to make sure voters are aware of what’s at stake this August.
* We’re up against a Republican supermajority that is beholden to the gun lobby and the campaign cash they receive from groups like the NRA. We can’t trust them when they say they’ll take action on guns, when the gun lobby continues to finance their campaigns.
* More than 80% of Tennessee voters agree that the time is NOW to take action on guns. We must meet this moment with action.

**OUR STRATEGY**
* At the end of the day, we have to turn out votes like never before. We have to reach new voters and make sure they’re ready to vote, as well as make sure that regular voters have the knowledge and plan they need to cast their ballot.
* We’re growing our digital program with ads and emails just like this one to reach voters where they are online, and to amplify the achievements and messages of the Democratic candidates we’re fighting for this summer.
* We’re creating events to recruit and train grassroots movement leaders and organizers to ensure that volunteers from Memphis to Mountain City have what they need to mobilize their communities.

**Here’s where you come in****, Peter****: Early contributions help us plan and strategize for the road ahead to elect Democrats across Tennessee. Please pitch in before tonight’s deadline to help fuel our work. **

Team, our critical May deadline is TONIGHT. **Here’s why why we absolutely can’t afford to miss our $25,000 goal:**

🚨 Jim Jordan is not fit to represent us in Congress. Instead of serving the American people, _he’s busy stumping for Donald Trump at NRA conventions!_

🚨Jim Jordan just said his TOP priority is stopping Democrats from retaking the House. _The GOP will do ANYTHING to destroy our democracy!_

**1\. Redistricting.** Last cycle, the New York State Legislature drew a congressional map that the New York State Courts deemed too partisan — so they threw it out and redrew it themselves. But Josh had a whole bunch of new territory in which to make himself known.

**2\. Primaries.** Josh had to win an expensive primary challenge in late August against a strong opponent. Still, Josh won the primary by a nearly two-to-one margin. _By working his butt off, not that he had much of a butt to start with—have you seen this guy? Beanpole!_

**3\. Marc Molinaro.** Josh’s Republican opponent in the general election had already been a State Assembly Member, County Executive and GOP candidate for governor in 2018, losing to then-Governor Cuomo. Molinaro gained wide name recognition and had no challengers in _his_ 2022 primary. But now he has a record to run on–and it’s not a good one. _He’s voting 95% of the time with Marjorie Taylor-Greene!_

**4\. Crazy GOP Attack Ads.** Republicans had momentum statewide, and they ran tons of deeply dishonest dark money ads that said crap like, “Josh Riley’s allies want to defund the police.” I don’t know who Josh’s “allies” are but Josh and I funded the police—getting crisis intervention training and bullet proof vests for local police departments across the country. _It was completely false, and it was sickening._

**5\. Midterm vs. Presidential Years.** 2024 will not be a midterm! Ultimately, too many New York Democrats didn’t show up in a number of races this past cycle. But this time, not only is the presidency on the line – so is the Supreme Court. You can bet Democrats will turn out!

Peter,

In December, my wife Janel and I lost our son, our granddaughter, and our soon-to-be daughter-in-law at the hands of a drunk driver. **I would have never let their tragic story become a part of my campaign were it not for the insane, woke policies of a select few executives at Mothers Against Drunk Driving.**

First, corporate America succumbed to the pressure of the woke left and disavowed conservatives. Now, it seems that nonprofit organizations, like Mothers Against Drunk Driving, are following suit.

**Let me read you in on what happened and why I’m reaching out with this story today.**
Recently, my wife and I accepted an invitation to be keynote speakers at a **Mothers Against Drunk Driving** event this July in Phoenix.

**We would have been the perfect fit.** Not only are we a law enforcement family, but we lost our kids to a drunk driving accident eight days before Christmas 2022.

Both Janel and I were looking forward to sharing our story. In my capacity as Pinal County Sheriff and as a father, the invitation meant so much. So, **you can imagine our disappointment and utter shock over the weekend when we got a call uninviting us as the keynote speakers**.

name: Sherrod Brown
subject: I’ll be honest with you

body:
| Hi Peter – before I ask you to chip in to help me win in Ohio and keep the Senate blue, I need to take a moment to explain why I'm in this fight and what your grassroots contribution would mean today.

I grew up in Mansfield, Ohio, in a community of ironworkers, carpenters, autoworkers, and electricians. I spent summers working on my family's farm. Today, I live in Cleveland with my wife, Connie, and our two rescue dogs, Franklin and Walter.

**I’ll be honest with you, Peter:** The Ohio I live in now looks a lot different than the one I grew up in. Over the years, we've seen manufacturing jobs shipped overseas because of bad trade deals, prices skyrocketing as wages failed to keep up, and hopes for a comfortable retirement dashed. That's why I've devoted my life to fighting for the Dignity of Work – the idea that hard work should pay off for everyone, no matter who you are, where you live, or what kind of work you do.

**Every day in the Senate, I’m fighting for _you._** But I’m facing my toughest race yet, and I need your help to win. Hi friend, A couple weeks ago, I joined dignitaries from Paterson, across New Jersey, and throughout the nation to celebrate the rebirth of the historic Hinchliffe Stadium, one of the few remaining Negro League stadiums left in existence. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/64135197/409079083/-197340401?refcode=230531_bp_EOM_img&ms=230531_bp_EOM&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQ0MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZWE3Nzk5NWEtZjRmZi1lZDExLTkwN2MtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=f7_AoE3UKI9kcE3U-H4fRzURATq7XJqnSXCvDy3HDpU=) Hinchliffe Stadium first opened in 1932 with assistance from FDR’s New Deal. For years and years, I fought to make Hinchliffe a National Landmark and we succeeded in passing a law adding the stadium to the Paterson Great Falls National Historic Park in 2015. As one of just a handful of Negro League stadiums left, we knew we had to protect this hallowed ground. We never gave up and pursued every avenue. Federal investments from the American Rescue Plan, National Park Service grants and federal Low Income Housing Tax Credits were essential to getting this restoration done. Alexander Hamilton used the power of the Great Falls to transform our city and birth the Industrial Revolution. Every generation of Patersonians has built on this legacy, and now new generations will get to enjoy this great park. **Date:** May 31, 2023

**To:** Maher for Congress Supporters

**Fr:** Team Maher

**Subject:** Maher for Congress Campaign Strategy - Update

Building upon Michael Maher's outstanding performance in 2022, the launch of the 2024 campaign has been a big success. With the 2024 Primary Election in California moving up to March 2024 instead of June, we accelerated our early efforts to consolidate support and begin the campaign's fundraising efforts. Both items are critical to unseating a multi-decade-serving incumbent Democrat Congressman and closing the partisan registration gap in the only remaining Democrat-controlled congressional district south of Stockton.

Steps completed and in process...

_**Step 1:**_ Building an experienced and winning team. Team Maher enlisted Ann Kramer as finance director. Ann has significant experience in the Central Valley, successfully raising funds for Speaker Kevin McCarthy, Congressman David Valadao, and Congressman John Duarte. Leading the campaign strategy is Tim Rosales, a seasoned campaign veteran with multiple wins for GOP candidates across the country running in Democrat-leaning districts.

_**Step 2:**_ Earning key endorsements. Michael Maher has earned the support of the Fresno County Republican Party, State Senator Shannon Grove, former Congresswoman Connie Conway, and a host of other local elected GOP leaders from the region.

_**Step 3:**_ Develop a grassroots and voter harvesting program that will increase GOP turnout in the 2024 election and identify independent and Democrat voters who are willing to vote for a common-sense, local Republican candidate like Michael Maher. Hi Peter, **In case you didn't hear the news, earlier this year a Jeep plant closed in Belvidere, Illinois, putting 1,350 hard working Americans out of a job.** The town of Belvidere sits about an hour northwest of Chicago, and has relied on auto assembly plants for jobs since the 1960s. What was once a plant that produced 190,000 Jeep Cherokees a year, employing about 5,000 people, now produced just around 20,000 in 2022. Auto manufacturer Stellantis recently shut down "indefinitely" in February 2023. The loss of a manufacturing plant is devastating, especially in rural areas. Those 1,350 workers have families, support small businesses, and can contribute to the community because of a steady job. **Without that security, their livelihoods, and the wellbeing of everyone in the town, is in danger.** This theme of shuttering manufacturing plants is a common thread across rural areas throughout the past few decades. It's also why we need political leaders who understand the enormous impact that these plants have on towns, and the need to make rural economies more resilient and ripe for job growth. That's why we support rural Democrats who understand the need for labor protection, investments in manufacturing competitiveness, skills training for the jobs of the future, affordable education, and support programs for those who are out of work. | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

Ron DeSantis

**RON DESANTIS GOT RESULTS FOR FLORIDA**
---
| | | **K-12 Education**

Parents' rights have been increasingly under assault around the nation, but in Florida, we stand up for the rights of parents and the fundamental role they play in the education of their children.
* School choice is available for all Floridians by eliminating enrollment caps and income requirements while still prioritizing lower-income families and expanding scholarships for students with special needs.

* Florida is now the first state in the nation to have school choice fully integrated in the public K-12 funding process.

* Florida is ranked #1 in education freedom, #1 in parental empowerment, #1 in state spending on private school choice, and #1 in school choice enrollment.

* Florida eliminated Critical Race Theory in its K-12 schools.

* In 2021 Florida created annual increases in scholarships for students with special needs and we provided $750 for transportation costs to the chosen school.

* Florida has established robust civics education requirements so that students learn about the constitution and what it means to be an American.

**Higher Education Reform**

Academia, writ large, across the country, has lost its way. In Florida, we're changing that with a series of reforms:
* Ending tenure by instating regular performance reviews.

* Dismantling the monopolistic style of higher ed accreditation agencies.

* Resetting the focus of higher ed towards preparing students to be contributing members of society, rather than imposing political ideology.

* Ensuring students and staff are evaluated based on merit and eliminating so-called D.E.I. programs, which are effectively programs based in discrimination, exclusion, and indoctrination.

**China**

Ron DeSantis has taken action to stand against the United States' greatest geopolitical threat -- the Chinese Communist Party (CCP). He signed legislation that:
* Prevents Chinese entities or affiliates from buying farmland in Florida or land near our military bases.

* Stops sensitive data from being stored on servers that might be owned by entities affiliated with the CCP.

* Prohibits the Chinese influence that we rooted out of higher education from working its way into our primary and secondary education institutions, including a prohibition on Confucious institutes.

* Blocks access to dangerous applications, such as TikTok, on government servers and devices.

**Protecting Life **
* The Heartbeat Protection Act protects the most vulnerable: babies in the womb whose hearts have already begun to beat.

**Defending 2nd Amendment Rights **
* Enacted constitutional carry that allows Floridians to carry concealed weapons without a government-issued permission slip.

**Law and Order**

Other states endanger their citizens by making it easier to put criminals back on the street. Here in Florida, we support and enact policies to protect our communities and keep our people safe. Governor DeSantis signed reforms that:
* Strengthen pre-trial detention and pushed back against woke "bail reform" efforts

* Increasing sentences for drug traffickers that target children with dangerous fentanyl.

* Subjected child rapists to the death penalty while simultaneously reforming death penalty statutes to ensure justice.

* Gov. DeSantis is also the only elected official in America to remove a "progressive" Soros-funded district attorney from office.

**Immigration**

The Biden Border Crisis has wreaked havoc across the United States and has put Americans in danger. But Governor DeSantis did not stand idly by while the federal government abandoned its lawful duties to protect our country, instead he:
* Mandated immigration status verification through E-Verify for public and private employers.

* Made knowingly transporting illegal immigrant minors a felony.

* Made using a fake ID to gain employment a felony.

* Required hospitals to report healthcare costs for illegal aliens.

* Gave Florida more money to send more illegal immigrants to more "sanctuary" jurisdictions such as Martha's Vineyard.

**Prescription Drugs**

Pharmacy benefit managers and Big Pharma have managed to escape the public eye and work in the shadows for far too long. Ron DeSantis signed a bill that takes the reins back from these healthcare monopolies while empowering consumers.
* With the legislation passed this session, drug companies must disclose wholesale drug price increases of 15% or more.

* Florida is also prohibiting pharmacy benefit managers from mandating mail orders.

**Tax Cuts**

Florida's economy has consistently outpaced the nation, but we are still fighting against inflationary policies imposed on us by the Biden administration. IIn Florida, we supported our residents and helped them afford the goods that they need.
* We lowered tolls across the state.

* We created a permanent tax exemption on diapers, wipes, baby clothes, cribs, strollers, and much more.

* We reduced taxes by nearly $5 billion - a Florida record.

**Legal Reform and Housing**

As Florida's population booms, we have provided record support for Florida's workforce to get quality housing and live the American Dream.
* The Live Local Act dedicates more than half a billion dollars to incentivize and jumpstart new construction.

* The Hometown Heroes Program makes sure police officers, firefighters, teachers, and other community leaders can afford to live in or near the communities they serve.

**Environmental, social, and corporate governance & Central Bank Digital Currency **

Ron DeSantis refuses to let elites circumvent the ballot box to implement a radical ideological agenda through financial sleight of hand.
* Governor DeSantis signed legislation that prohibits the financial sector from considering so-called "Social Credit Scores" in banking and lending practices that aim to prevent Floridians from obtaining loans, lines of credit, and bank accounts.

* And Governor DeSantis is on the record: NO to CBDCs or Federally-controlled digital dollar. Any proposal will be dead on arrival.

**Let Kids Be Kids **

There is a disturbing trend in our society to try to sexualize young people. That is not the way you look out for our children. You protect children--and Governor DeSantis has, by signing landmark legislation that:
* Prohibits sex reassignment surgeries and prescriptions for children under 18.

* Bans children from attending drag shows.

* Protects students from having to "declare" their pronouns in school and ensures that students are not forced to use pronouns that are not based on a student's biological sex.

* Expands parents' rights in the education of their children by prohibiting classroom instruction on sexual orientation and gender identity in Pre-K through 8th grade.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fbb3aec9d914493ca09281bf6d091c9c&_e=j7zIEXLyF3dl7oiqMDwCQ_2odGJunDVgLSEexbBr7M-FM1E-uwCuMSyyuZzy2M1j4WlM5znXj1FO1DJkMd21T8j2s195Jjtk7hQHbPLfhLZuMcxrofA5aPXjNhCkKJgBC21dxBFVC7D6bhU39eB4GSs_KrJNnSLvCBbylTjNuTpko34mOptG_jb7o-B3RWd0KNPKy3BggWc5xcr0rV_BObcyJDlnO1csWjOlnu1niomyeG7P2rOd4mTW_ZI9xpFvCqTbir2vdtfMuF0jk_avHDukcfnh35EUfnbLk9pES6KHSor00IyjEE9Ke5_FGCkvAMS3lbdqqGnU5ZbdT-AMjNCU1lMSZrdGnV8vaDzhk5OAOiJsml2QemYkO3m1O4hSfgqCMN9ZhbOCn6r2IDLuPvs2QladPopdDJLBgvDrPy8%3D) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled "The Second World Wars."
Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. clean_body: Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled "The Second World Wars." Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. If you'd like to secure a DVD set before they're all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College. Here's a secure link to reserve your copy of "The Second World Wars " on DVD: Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College! **And as Ranking Member the House Committee on Veterans’ Affairs, I am hard at work to make sure our government lives up to that duty.

But sadly, our committee found a serious, unique threat to veterans: Veterans are being targeted by violent, right-wing extremist groups for recruitment.**

**Last year the U.S. Forest Service set a prescribed fire that destroyed over 400 New Mexicans’ homes.** As of April this year, only 13 households have received any financial relief from the federal government. In early March, Rep. Gabe Vasquez sent a letter to the U.S. Forest Service Chief asking for an action plan to prevent detrimental mistakes like this from happening again and updates for the impacted residents. **Hearing no response from the agency, Gabe pressed Chief Moore directly in a congressional hearing this month.** | “If one federal agency causes a catastrophic fire that causes 400 people to lose their home and says now it's FEMA’s problem then people, rightfully so, are not going to have trust in the government. **A problem caused by the federal government must be fixed by the federal government.** ”
---
After Gabe called out the dysfunction between the government agencies, [the USDA created a new partnership with FEMA](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/64137944/409089428/1753460771?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzAxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NDJhYjFiMy1mZGZmLWVkMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=anZozYCVNH7sCbzDUhIBQJ7jXVpmnEOAnh7C3AqvrWE=&emci=44a26a70-01fc-ed11-907c-00224832eb73&emdi=742ab1b3-fdff-ed11-907c-00224832eb73&ceid=4482565) to speed up the process of getting New Mexico families' homes restored at no cost to the fire victims.

| | Dear Fellow American,
American civics education, and specifically the teaching of American history, is at a crisis point.
In K-12 schools nationwide, false narratives are being constructed, and content is being cherry-picked to fit an ideological (and frankly anti-American) agenda. Maybe you've even seen this happening in your local schools.
As a result, we are faced with a choice: will we allow our children to be indoctrinated using curricula developed by anti-American ideologues and promoted by Left-wing education bureaucrats?
Or will we insist that our children are taught honestly, using a curriculum that presents a fair, unbiased, and comprehensive view of our nation's history?
We must insist on the **latter** , both for the sake of truth and for the sake of our children and America's future.
For this reason, we have produced the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ --and I'm writing to ask your help in promoting this curriculum to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide.
**What is the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_? **
The**_Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_** is a K-12 history and civics curriculum that covers the triumphs and tragedies of American history fairly and comprehensively.
This curriculum has been designed not by activists or ideologues but by teachers and professors at Hillsdale College--and we are making it available **free of charge**.
To be clear, the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ is not a _slap-dash_ response to the efforts of anti-American ideologues to indoctrinate our children.
It is a 2,000-page, 85-lesson curriculum based on decades of studying American history. Developed over 18 months of intense and focused effort, its roots extend as far back as the beginning of Hillsdale College in 1844.
And we need your help to make the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ available to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide...and to make it available **free of charge** so that it will have the greatest impact.
_We have set a budget goal of $400,000 to promote the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ and our other outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and our classical K-12 charter school initiative. _
That's an ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible.
One reason why your support really matters: **Hillsdale College refuses to accept one penny in taxpayer support --not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans**. This makes our work uniquely dependent on the support of citizens like you--citizens who agree with Hillsdale's mission on behalf of liberty.
We remind ourselves daily of Hillsdale's 179-year-old mission--to provide "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty."
With that mission in mind, we produced the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ --and now we need your help to promote it nationwide.
Will you take this opportunity to _**support the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_ and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty?**_
Understanding that a proper education is vital to the preservation of liberty--and that the anti-American indoctrination now being forced on too many American children poses an existential threat to liberty--I hope you will make your most generous tax-deductible gift today.

name: Peter Welch
subject: your mental health
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT
body:
It's important

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=1265%2E61531%2EzErk9c)
Hi Friend,
As we reach the end of the month, I’m reflecting on May being Mental Health Awareness Month. It’s a time for us to raise awareness around mental health and combat the lingering stigma that still surrounds it.
More than one in five people in the U.S. live with mental illness. That means tens of millions of people struggle with their mental health. But even though it’s incredibly common, there’s still a stigma surrounding the issue.
Think of it this way: If you fall down and break your arm, the natural decision is to go to the doctor or the emergency room. But for folks struggling with their mental health or having a mental health crisis, there’s still stigma surrounding seeing a mental health provider.
Too many people are suffering in silence. It’s on all of us to break the stigma. Checking in with your friends and family can make a world of difference, and that can start with a simple conversation.
I’m taking stock of my own mental health and the mental health of my loved ones. I hope all of you can too.
Take care of yourself,
Peter Welch

Peter, what happened here?
---
Two days ago, I reached out to this powerful community asking for support – and the initial response was _overwhelming._
We shot up toward our 500 Team James May Memberships goal. But then, out of nowhere it seems, donations came to a standstill – and now we're on the verge of falling short of our May goal by 230 donations.
I’ll be honest: I’m disappointed that we may fall short of this goal, but I _refuse_ to let it get the best of me. I’m confident in the size and strength of this team – **and that’s why I’m asking you to help us make up this gap with only hours left to go. **
**Peter, I’m counting on you to be one of the 230 people I need to make a donation, so please:** **[Will you give any amount before 11:59 p.m. to help power my fight for progress?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/64140735/409100436/-2022127741?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1093-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTg0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMTA4YjVlYS0wNjAwLWVlMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_aEXbjTgeAn4OEU3ePcGeiFEUcW95G9ndiMBLo-G2PY=)**

Peter, in a moment [**I’m going to ask you to contribute to my progressive campaign**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/64140738/409100438/-2022127741?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1093-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTg0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMTA4YjVlYS0wNjAwLWVlMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_aEXbjTgeAn4OEU3ePcGeiFEUcW95G9ndiMBLo-G2PY=), but first I wanted to explain what’s at stake.
I didn’t grow up with power or privilege.
I had no special strings to tug on and no way to stop the manipulative landlords, predatory lenders, and powerful corporations that had ruled New York for _generations_ from preying on families like my own. I felt voiceless.
When we made history in 2018 by helping me become the first Black woman ever to serve as New York’s attorney general, I knew that I had to do everything in my power to _never_ let another American feel how I did then – and I’m proud to say that that’s exactly what I’ve worked toward.
Peter, during my time in office, I have taken gun manufacturers and sellers to court, won over a BILLION dollars from Big Pharma for New Yorkers harmed from the opioid epidemic, taken legal action against attorneys general in other states to defend LGBTQ+ children from their harmful laws, fought tirelessly for reproductive freedom, and _more_.
**But I’ll level with you: Being a champion of the people has made me an _enemy_ of the powerful and corrupt. And, as a Black woman who has had to fight every second to get to this platform, I cannot take anything for granted.**
That’s why I’m asking for your support today, Peter. Because, even though you helped me make history _once again_ and win reelection in November, my hard work is nowhere near complete – especially with the powerful and corrupt sizing up my every move to see where they can cut me down.
**I need to raise at least $10,000 to keep pace with my 2023 goals, so please:[Will you rush a donation of $5 or more before my fundraiser ends at 11:59 p.m. tomorrow night? I can only win my fight for progress with your help.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/64140739/409100439/-2022127741?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1093-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTg0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMTA4YjVlYS0wNjAwLWVlMTEtOTA3Yy0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_aEXbjTgeAn4OEU3ePcGeiFEUcW95G9ndiMBLo-G2PY=)**

body:
Join us at our upcoming 46th Annual Dinner - Get your tickets now!

http://wsrp.org
Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WeGlgXqOx-Y

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

Gabby Giffords

The Michigan State Senate is allocating $175 million in _**state funds**_ towards a factory planned _by Chinese manufacturer Gotion._

I was supposed to be in Pennsylvania this week meeting with constituents, but, hello from Washington
| | |

Derek, I was supposed to be in Pennsylvania this week meeting with constituents, but, hello from Washington. _At last_ , it looks like we have a bipartisan agreement to raise the debt ceiling, stop a default, and follow through on the commitments we made to slow climate change via the Inflation Reduction Act, and invest in our infrastructure via the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act. This is good news.

What’s not good news is what I just learned from my campaign team: They let me know that we’re still falling short of our end-of-month goal.
**That’s why I’m emailing right now, Derek: Will you pitch in $5 to help us hit our May end-of-month goal of $5,000 before our deadline at 11:59 p.m. tonight?
